Definition (EN): to manage with something inadequate
Example Sentence: With a third of the budget they just make do.
例句翻译: 预算只有三分之一，只能将就。
Usage Note: make do with（某物）＝凑合用。make do without=没有也凑合过。

Definition (EN): to learn how to do something
台词翻译: 我们年轻老师还在摸索门道。
Example Sentence: It took me a month to get the hang of the reporting software.
例句翻译: 我花了一个月才摸熟那套报表软件。
Usage Note: 名词 the hang of sth＝诀窍（近义 knack）。

Definition (EN): to survive an ordeal
释义（中文）: 活着出来；总算挺过来了
台词翻译: 我当老师就是为了确保学生能活着走出来。
Example Sentence: Two hundred candidates came out of the interview alive.
例句翻译: 两百个候选人总算面完活下来了。
Usage Note: 夸张说法，表示过程摧残但人挺住了。

Definition (EN): to feel in control and handling things well
释义（中文）: 得心应手；一切尽在掌握
Quote from Episode: I finally feel on top of things.
台词翻译: 我终于觉得一切尽在掌握了。
Example Sentence: After the system upgrade she felt on top of things again.
例句翻译: 系统升级后她又一次觉得尽在掌握。
Usage Note: 反义 feel out of depth（力不从心）。on top of 还可指「在…之上」。

Definition (EN): an alternative if the first option fails
Quote from Episode: And the rug was Plan B?!
台词翻译: 所以地毯是 B 计划？！
Example Sentence: If the budget won't stretch, Plan B is a phased rollout.
例句翻译: 预算不够的话，B 方案是分阶段上线。
Usage Note: 日常口语＝退路。正式商务语境常见。

Definition (EN): a place that reduces anxiety
台词翻译: 地毯对孩子来说就像一个让人平静的地方。
Example Sentence: A quiet room works as a calming space during meltdown.
例句翻译: 崩溃期一个安静的房间能起到让人平静的作用。
Usage Note: 空间/场所描述的高频组合，职场谈办公环境也用。

Definition (EN): a devout, upright woman
释义（中文）: 上帝的女人；虔诚正直的女人
Quote from Episode: I'm Barbara Howard, woman of God.
台词翻译: 我是 Barbara Howard，上帝的女人。
Example Sentence: She'd probably describe herself as a woman of God.
例句翻译: 她大概会自称是上帝的女人。
Usage Note: 宗教圈的自我介绍；常带自嘲意味。

Definition (EN): one behind another in a line
Quote from Episode: Out in the hallway in a single file.
Example Sentence: Line up single file and follow the teacher.
例句翻译: 排成一列跟着老师走。
Usage Note: 美国学校常用；英国多说 in a line。

Definition (EN): an expert at a hands-on tool
Quote from Episode: a wizard with a glue gun
Example Sentence: He's a wizard with Excel; ask him anything.
例句翻译: Excel 用得问他就行，他是个高手。
Usage Note: 结构：a wizard with sth。也可说 a whiz at／a guru at。

Definition (EN): the teacher's comment on a school report
Quote from Episode: She wrote in my report card note
台词翻译: 她在我的成绩单评语里写道……
Example Sentence: His report card note said 'a joy to teach'.
例句翻译: 他的成绩单评语写着「教起来很轻松」。
Usage Note: 美式；英式说 school report。报告单本身叫 report card。

Definition (EN): too attached and reluctant to leave
Example Sentence: New joiners can come across as clingy in week one.
例句翻译: 新人第一周容易显得不合群、黏人。
Usage Note: 带负面评价。反义 independent。cling to=紧抓不放。

Definition (EN): a person who is very entertaining
Example Sentence: Everyone says Marcus is a hoot to work with.
例句翻译: 大家都说跟 Marcus 共事特别有意思。
Usage Note: 20 世纪早期指笑点，现多用于夸人风趣。

Definition (EN): to be routed to the junk folder
Quote from Episode: It must have gone to spam.
Example Sentence: Your filters sent the offer to spam again.
例句翻译: 过滤器又把那份录用通知扔进垃圾箱了。
Usage Note: 也作 end up in the spam folder。名词 spam folder。

Definition (EN): a bond formed through shared hardship
释义（中文）: 创伤联结；共患难建立的情谊
Example Sentence: Nine people on the same team for two years builds trauma bonding.
例句翻译: 同队共事两年会形成一种共患难的默契。
Usage Note: 心理学概念，本指被虐待后产生的依恋；职场泛指一起扛过事的关系。

Definition (EN): a nickname expressing affection
Quote from Episode: it's like a term of endearment
Example Sentence: "Big man" is how his crew uses it as a term of endearment.
例句翻译: 「大哥」是他队友的昵称。
Usage Note: 与 insult（侮辱）相对——同一个词语境不同含义完全不同。

Definition (EN): a hundred dollars
台词翻译: 一百美元，大写叫 a C-note。
Example Sentence: The deposit was two C-notes and he still walked away.
例句翻译: 押金是两个 C-note（大写一百），他还是走了。
Usage Note: 大写 C 是罗马数字 100。连字＝grand（千美元）。

Definition (EN): to apply a veneer of class to something shabby
Quote from Episode: you can't class up a rug
Example Sentence: You cannot class up a cracked vinyl floor with a rug.
例句翻译: 一块开裂的地胶盖块毯子也装不出体面。
Usage Note: 来自 class 作动词＝「使显得高级」。带轻蔑。

Definition (EN): any publicity, even negative, helps
Quote from Episode: No press is bad press, Barb.
Example Sentence: Local papers are running with it — no press is bad press.
例句翻译: 本地报纸都在炒这事——没新闻才是坏新闻。
Usage Note: 源自 press agent 行业。常用反讽，语境多为批评。

Definition (EN): continuing to do very well
台词翻译: 看看梅尔·吉布森，照样滋润。
Example Sentence: The brand weathered three scandals and is still thriving.
例句翻译: 这品牌扛了三次丑闻，照样活得好好的。
Usage Note: 此处是讽刺。反义 struggling（艰难维持）。

Definition (EN): not given enough money to work
台词翻译: 经费不足、管理不善的公立学校
Example Sentence: Underfunded programmes always cut the training budget first.
例句翻译: 经费不足的项目总是先砍培训预算。
Usage Note: 常与 understaffed、oversubscribed 连用。

Definition (EN): stay alert behind you
台词翻译: 今早有个学生让我注意身后。
Example Sentence: On a crowded subway, mind your six.
例句翻译: 挤地铁时留意身后。
Usage Note: six＝六点钟方向（背后）。军队／警察俚语，日常是玩笑。

Definition (EN): to have almost no effect
释义（中文）: 作用跟…差不多（等于没用）
Quote from Episode: My support was gonna do about as much
台词翻译: 我的支持作用跟那个五号文胸差不多。
Example Sentence: A polite email will do about as much as a raised eyebrow.
例句翻译: 一封客气的邮件效果跟挑眉差不多。
Usage Note: 否定语境常接无用的东西，表示「聊胜于无也没有」。

Definition (EN): good at solving problems creatively
Example Sentence: He was resourceful enough to build it from spare parts.
例句翻译: 他有办法用零件把它拼出来。
Usage Note: 形容词来自 resource；职场评价高频，比 smart 更褒义。

Definition (EN): to endure until the end
Quote from Episode: stick it out longer than two years?
台词翻译: 你们怎么都撑不过两年？
Example Sentence: The first quarter is brutal; most people can't stick it out.
例句翻译: 第一个季度很熬，多数人撑不下来。
Usage Note: stick it out＝硬撑完。反义 quit。

Definition (EN): the rate at which staff leave and are replaced
台词翻译: 人员流动比面包店还勤。
Example Sentence: Their turnover is double the industry average.
例句翻译: 他们的流动率是行业均值的两倍。
Usage Note: 此处双关 turnover＝面团翻面／烤制。HR 通用词。

Definition (EN): inappropriate; crossing a line
Example Sentence: His remarks were out of line for a staff meeting.
例句翻译: 他那番话在员工会上不合适。
Usage Note: 反义 in line。职场批评常用。

Definition (EN): to face more opponents than you
Example Sentence: In that meeting five directors outnumbered us.
例句翻译: 那次会上我们寡不敌众，对面五位董事。
Usage Note: 反义 outnumber（数量压过）。

Definition (EN): a distinctly original opinion (often ironic)
Quote from Episode: She has a unique take on her job.
台词翻译: 她对这份工作有独特的见解。
Example Sentence: His unique take on process management is mostly absence of process.
例句翻译: 他对流程管理的独特见解，基本等于没有流程。
Usage Note: take＝看法。职场里 unique 常是反话，等于「有问题」。

Definition (EN): clothing valued for usefulness over style
释义（中文）: 功能性时尚（只求能穿不讲好看）
Example Sentence: Teachers live in functional fashion.
例句翻译: 老师们穿的都是能穿就行。
Usage Note: 自嘲式说法，职场里也可泛指「够用就行」。

Definition (EN): a required interval before something can happen
Example Sentence: There's a two-week waiting period before you're eligible.
例句翻译: 要等两周才具备资格。
Usage Note: HR/保险高频词，比 waiting list 精确。

Definition (EN): to make sure a rule is obeyed
Quote from Episode: if we're not gonna enforce it?
台词翻译: 要是我们不打算执行呢？
Example Sentence: A policy nobody enforces is not a policy.
例句翻译: 没人执行的制度等于不存在。
Usage Note: 职场高频：制度存在但 enforce 不到位是最常见的抱怨。反义违抗。

Definition (EN): present at an event
Example Sentence: Attendance is compulsory for all staff.
例句翻译: 所有员工必须出席。
Usage Note: 正式语体，比 here 一词正式。动词 attend。

Definition (EN): to exhaust or overwhelm you with work
Quote from Episode: double class is kicking my ass.
台词翻译: 这个连堂课快把我累死了
Example Sentence: The end-of-quarter workload is kicking my ass.
例句翻译: 季末的工作量快把我压垮了。
Usage Note: 粗俗但极常用。ass 在此不是屁股。

Definition (EN): to have not yet completed your share of work
Example Sentence: I'm behind on my reviews and it's only Tuesday.
例句翻译: 我的评审还欠着，才周二呢。
Usage Note: 职场高频。可接具体任务，也可接进度。

Definition (EN): to reach the current level after falling behind
Quote from Episode: I'm doing LEGO day to catch up.
Example Sentence: We spent the morning catching up on the backlog.
例句翻译: 我们用一上午赶积压的进度。
Usage Note: 职场搭配 catch up on work / on the backlog；on 后面才接内容。

Definition (EN): financial backing in exchange for publicity
Quote from Episode: LEGO owes me a sponsorship already
Example Sentence: They rejected the sponsorship budget twice.
例句翻译: 赞助预算他们拒了两次。
Usage Note: 动词 sponsor。对比 donate（无商业回报的捐赠）。

Definition (EN): a tank of water for sensory-deprivation relaxation
台词翻译: 比我家那个漂浮缸还强烈
Example Sentence: She floated for an hour in the tank.
例句翻译: 她在缸里漂了一个小时。
Usage Note: 也叫 sensory deprivation tank；动词 float＝漂浮。

Definition (EN): to accept or overlook wrongdoing
Example Sentence: The school won't condone harassment.
例句翻译: 学校不会纵容骚扰行为。
Usage Note: 强否定意义，常用于政策声明。condone＝容忍，condemn＝谴责，别混。

Definition (EN): a performance so vivid it feels real
Example Sentence: The staging made it a book come to life.
例句翻译: 这套舞台让它成了一本活过来的书。
Usage Note: 固定搭配，也说 bring sth to life。

Definition (EN): to have missed something obvious that everyone else caught
释义（中文）: （好资源）一直没人发现；被集体忽略
Example Sentence: This restaurant has been slept on for years.
例句翻译: 这家馆子被低估了好几年。
Usage Note: 意思是「没注意到、没当回事」，不是「注意到」。常说 the market slept on the news（市场对这条消息毫无反应）。近义：overlook, ignore, miss。注意与 sleep on it（考虑一晚再定）区分。

Definition (EN): to dismiss as worthless or hopeless
台词翻译: 人们就把这个地方一笔带过
Example Sentence: Don't write off the proposal before you've read it.
例句翻译: 没看完之前别就把这份提案否掉。
Usage Note: 职场常用：write off a risk / an idea。写坏���用 write off（核销）。

Definition (EN): an area with little access to affordable food
释义（中文）: 食品荒漠（缺乏食品供应的城区）
台词翻译: 人们就把这个地区一笔带过
Example Sentence: Two new supermarkets turned a food desert into a food oasis.
例句翻译: 两家新超市把食品荒漠变成了食品绿洲。
Usage Note: 城市政策术语；对比 food oasis（食品绿洲）。

Definition (EN): to prepare for work
Example Sentence: She's prepping for parent-teacher conferences all week.
例句翻译: 她整周都在准备家长会。
Usage Note: 口语缩写 prep。prepare 的宾语常被省略。

Definition (EN): a statement that one accepts blame for a crime
Quote from Episode: we apprehended three individuals and placed them into custody
Example Sentence: His signed confession was read as an admission of guilt.
例句翻译: 他签字的口供被当作了认罪。
Usage Note: 法律固定搭配；guiltless / not guilty 才是无罪。

Definition (EN): to catch or arrest someone officially
Quote from Episode: we apprehended three individuals and placed them into custody
台词翻译: 我们逮捕了三名嫌疑人并将其收押。
Example Sentence: Two men were apprehended after the raid.
例句翻译: 突袭后有两名男子被捕。
Usage Note: 常用被动式 be apprehended by；名词 apprehension 指「理解」时读 /ˌæprɪˈhenʃən/。

Definition (EN): held by police, not yet sentenced
Example Sentence: He's been in custody since March.
例句翻译: 他自三月起一直被羁押。
Usage Note: take someone into custody 为「逮捕」；in prison 指已服刑。

Definition (EN): to reduce something noticeably
释义（中文）: 给…造成打击；使…明显下降
Quote from Episode: put this big a dent in the local drug trade
台词翻译: 对本地毒品交易造成这么大冲击。
Example Sentence: The new cameras put a real dent in speeding.
例句翻译: 新摄像头让超速明显减少。
Usage Note: 也说 make a dent in；big a dent 为强调语气。

Definition (EN): observing an experienced person at work
Quote from Episode: I'll take you on a ride-along
Example Sentence: He did a few ride-alongs before carrying a weapon.
例句翻译: 在配枪前他先随行观摩过几次。
Usage Note: 警务与军队用语；搭配 go on a ride-along。

Definition (EN): false or imitation, as a prefix
Quote from Episode: That faux-Lalique vase I picked up at the Super-Swap
台词翻译: 那是我在二手店淘的仿拉利克花瓶。
Example Sentence: The counter was faux-marble.
例句翻译: 台面是仿大理石的。
Usage Note: 读 /foʊ/，不读 /fjuː/；常见 faux-leather、faux-fur。

Definition (EN): to reach a set savings minimum
Example Sentence: Few households have savings to meet their reserve.
例句翻译: 很少有家庭的储蓄能达到自定的储备线。
Usage Note: 经济与保险用语；近义 break even。

Definition (EN): unable to be treated by surgery
Example Sentence: The tumour is inoperable, so chemo is the only option.
例句翻译: 肿瘤无法手术，化疗是唯一选择。
Usage Note: 反义 operable；名词 inoperability。

Definition (EN): the most favourable possible outcome
Quote from Episode: Best-case scenario, with chemo, I'll live maybe another couple years.
台词翻译: 最理想的情况下，加上化疗我大概还能活两三年。
Example Sentence: Even in the best-case scenario it takes a year.
例句翻译: 即便最理想也要一年。
Usage Note: 对应 worst-case scenario；正式写作常用。

Definition (EN): lacking enough staff to work properly
Example Sentence: We're shorthanded; please reschedule.
例句翻译: 我们人手不足，请改期。
Usage Note: 职场书面语，口语说 understaffed。

Definition (EN): to clean a surface with a damp cloth
Quote from Episode: I need you to do some wipe-downs.
台词翻译: 我需要你去做一些擦拭。
Example Sentence: The checklist ends with a wipe-down of the counter.
例句翻译: 清单最后一项是擦拭台面。
Usage Note: 服务业常用，口语拼作 wipe down；名词 wipe-down。

Definition (EN): official permission to go ahead
Example Sentence: The board gave the plan the green light.
例句翻译: 董事会批准了这个方案。
Usage Note: give / get the green light；反义 red light；注意冠词 the。

Definition (EN): said to acknowledge a message is understood
Example Sentence: Radio check, copy that.
例句翻译: 通讯测试，收到。
Usage Note: 无线电确认用语，口语常缩为 copy。

Definition (EN): to surrender oneself to police
Quote from Episode: Either that or I turn you in.
台词翻译: 要么合伙，要么我把你交出去。
Example Sentence: He turned himself in after three days.
例句翻译: 三天后他去自首了。
Usage Note: 此处重音落在 in；「交作业」的 turn in 重音在 turn。

Definition (EN): to develop into or come to amount to
Quote from Episode: I never expected you to amount to much
台词翻译: 我从没指望你能有什么出息。
Example Sentence: He started as a dishwasher and ended up running the kitchen.
例句翻译: 他从洗碗工做起，最后管起了后厨。
Usage Note: amount to nothing 即「没出息」；带轻微失望意味。

Definition (EN): to tell someone rudely to go away
Quote from Episode: You ain't Welcome Back Kotter, so step off.
台词翻译: 你那套《回到科特威尔》收起来吧，走开。
Example Sentence: I said I'm not interested. Step off.
例句翻译: 我说没兴趣，走开。
Usage Note: 带轻蔑，不是中性的 step off the gas。

Definition (EN): a very brief remark, often ironic
释义（中文）: 简短发言；（反讽）三言两语
Example Sentence: He gave his acceptance as a two-line speech.
例句翻译: 他用两句话作了个简短发言。
Usage Note: 单独说 short speech 常带「我说完了，就这些」的不耐烦。

Definition (EN): to evaluate the quality of someone's work
Quote from Episode: I could critique it for you
Example Sentence: She critiqued the draft and returned it an hour later.
例句翻译: 她批评了一遍草稿，一小时后还回来。
Usage Note: 及物用法 critique something；也可作名词。

Definition (EN): someone unable to cope, said lightly
Quote from Episode: You're gonna be a complete basket case.
台词翻译: 到时候你整个人都要崩了。
Example Sentence: By finals he was a total basket case.
例句翻译: 期末他整个人都是崩的。
Usage Note: 源自1918年流感时的旧分类标签；比 nervous wreck 更夸张。

Definition (EN): emotional upheaval in middle age
Example Sentence: The novel is about a mid-life crisis.
例句翻译: 这部小说写的是中年危机。
Usage Note: 形容词 mid-life；也常说 male mid-life crisis。

Definition (EN): the highlight of a series
Quote from Episode: But the pièce de résistance: a round bottom boiling flask.
Example Sentence: The final lecture was the pièce de résistance.
例句翻译: 最后那堂课是压轴。
Usage Note: 法语借词，字面「抵抗之物」；重音在 ré。

Definition (EN): substances added to dilute a product
Example Sentence: The lab closed for adding adulterants.
例句翻译: 那家实验室因掺杂物被查封。
Usage Note: 食品与药品监管用语；动词 adulterate。

Definition (EN): a distinctive personal touch
Example Sentence: The extra garlic is her signature.
例句翻译: 多加蒜是她的招牌。
Usage Note: 此处是「个人风格」义，不是「签名」。

Definition (EN): don't take risks in your own home turf
释义（中文）: 别在自己地盘上干有风险的事
Quote from Episode: I don't shit where I eat.
台词翻译: 我不干那种在自己家搞事的事。
Example Sentence: Don't shit where you eat—keep the books clean.
例句翻译: 别在自己地盘上冒险，账目要干净。
Usage Note: 源自工程与军队俚语；粗俗但常见的商业警句。

Definition (EN): deliberately vague to avoid the question
Example Sentence: His answer was evasive.
例句翻译: 他的回答含糊其辞。
Usage Note: 动词 evade；商务与法律常用。

Definition (EN): a remote rural area
Quote from Episode: drive way out in the boonies
Example Sentence: They bought a place in the boonies.
例句翻译: 他们在荒郊买了房子。
Usage Note: 美式口语，正式用 remote countryside。

Definition (EN): does not make sense to me
Example Sentence: The numbers add up but the story doesn't compute.
例句翻译: 数字对得上，但事说不通。
Usage Note: 用计算比喻思维，1960年代起流行。

Definition (EN): it is getting late; hurry up
Example Sentence: Daylight's burning—pack up.
例句翻译: 天快黑了，收东西。
Usage Note: 原指伐木工收工；现等于 time is running out。

Definition (EN): something very good or impressive
Example Sentence: Her presentation was the bomb.
例句翻译: 她的演讲太棒了。
Usage Note: 1990年代美式俚语，略显老派。

Definition (EN): completely flat; said humorously
Example Sentence: The bread came out flat as a washboard.
例句翻译: 面包烤得跟搓板一样。
Usage Note: 双关，也用来形容毫无起伏。

Definition (EN): the weapon or bag you normally carry
Example Sentence: He only carries one knife—his daily carry.
例句翻译: 他只带一把刀，那就是他的随身装备。
Usage Note: 源自 EDC（everyday carry）文化。

Definition (EN): to bring enough force to finish the job
释义（中文）: 带上足够的家伙；备足筹码
Quote from Episode: If you're gonna bring a gun, you gotta bring enough gun.
Example Sentence: He brought enough gun to outlast them.
例句翻译: 他备足了火力撑过他们。
Usage Note: gun 为「实力」比喻，源自枪械。

Definition (EN): a short speech praising someone with a raised glass
Quote from Episode: A little toast to my brother-in-law.
Example Sentence: He raised his glass for a toast.
例句翻译: 他举杯祝酒。
Usage Note: make / propose a toast。

Definition (EN): a simile for being slow-witted
Quote from Episode: you got a brain the size of Wisconsin
台词翻译: 你脑子就威斯康星州那么大。
Example Sentence: He has a brain the size of a pea.
例句翻译: 他脑子只有豌豆大。
Usage Note: 英语里常见的「笨蛋」谚语模式。

Definition (EN): good-hearted despite flaws
Quote from Episode: your heart's in the right place
Example Sentence: He's clumsy but his heart's in the right place.
例句翻译: 他笨手笨脚但心眼不坏。
Usage Note: 近义 have good intentions；反义 have a cold heart。

Definition (EN): judging by the current pace
Quote from Episode: At this rate, in 50 or 60 years, you'll be rich.
台词翻译: 照这个速度五六十年你就富了。
Example Sentence: At this rate we'll miss the deadline.
例句翻译: 照这样我们赶不上期限。
Usage Note: 后接 will / won't 结果。

Definition (EN): provided the terms are favourable
Example Sentence: We'll move if the price is right.
例句翻译: 价钱合适我们就搬。
Usage Note: 谈判套话，不真的只谈价钱。

Definition (EN): to be self-righteous and uptight
Example Sentence: He's all sticks-up-his-ass about paperwork.
例句翻译: 他对文件手续一本正经得不得了。
Usage Note: 动词 stick it up your ass 意为「别那么拘谨」，与形容词相反。

Definition (EN): to suddenly turn to wrongdoing
Example Sentence: Two good neighbourhoods broke bad in a decade.
例句翻译: 两个好社区十年里就堕落了。
Usage Note: 剧名由此而来；区别 break down（出故障）。

Definition (EN): to inform on someone
Quote from Episode: He thinks maybe you dimed on him.
Example Sentence: Nobody dimed on anyone.
例句翻译: 没人出卖谁。
Usage Note: 近义 rat on someone；与名词 dime（角币）无关。

Definition (EN): an offensive word for an informer
Example Sentence: He thought his partner was a ratasnitch.
例句翻译: 他以为搭档是告密的。
Usage Note: 近义 snitch、informant；带强烈侮辱色彩。

Definition (EN): there is no time to waste; hurry
Example Sentence: Ain't got all day, the train leaves in twenty.
例句翻译: 没时间了，车二十分钟后开。
Usage Note: 正式说法 hurry up；ain't 为非标准缩合。

Definition (EN): to exclude from information or feelings
Example Sentence: He shut her out after the second year.
例句翻译: 他大二之后就把她排除在外了。
Usage Note: shut someone out of something。

Definition (EN): with extra force and determination
Example Sentence: He returned to the ring with a vengeance.
例句翻译: 他重返拳坛，杀气十足。
Usage Note: 来自圣经「报复」意象；加强语气。

Definition (EN): to be released on bond
Example Sentence: He made bail after his arraignment.
例句翻译: 他在传讯后获得保释。
Usage Note: 法律用语；post bail 为缴纳保释金。

Definition (EN): to fail a course
Example Sentence: He flunked chemistry twice.
例句翻译: 他化学挂过两次。
Usage Note: 非正式；正式用 fail。

Definition (EN): a mask protecting the lungs from fumes
Example Sentence: Meth labs require full-face respirators.
例句翻译: 制毒实验室需要全脸防护呼吸器。
Usage Note: 比 mask 专业；动词 respire。

Definition (EN): a person or thing that saves you from a bad situation
Example Sentence: The spare tyre was a real life saver.
例句翻译: 那个备胎真是救了命。
Usage Note: 口语。life-saver 也指救生圈，字面双关。

Definition (EN): respect and admiration
Example Sentence: Mad props to you for covering for me.
例句翻译: 替我圆场这份情我记下了。
Usage Note: 1990年代黑人俚语，props 是 proper 的变音；年轻人多用 shout-out。

Definition (EN): a stupid, clumsy move
台词翻译: 那是个蠢到家了的操作。
Example Sentence: Reading the map while driving is a bonehead maneuver.
例句翻译: 开车时看地图是很蠢的行为。
Usage Note: bonehead=笨蛋，美式口语；英式更常说 daft。

Definition (EN): remain optimistic and not dwell on problems
Quote from Episode: We're just gonna stay positive, right?
Example Sentence: Stay positive; the interview went better than you think.
例句翻译: 往好处想，那次面试比你以为的好。
Usage Note: 此处是心理安慰，不是数学上的「保持为正」。

Definition (EN): to stop being connected and go on alone
Quote from Episode: we will go our separate ways
Example Sentence: The two brothers went their separate ways after the lawsuit.
例句翻译: 打完官司后兄弟俩就分道扬镳了。
Usage Note: 也作 go your separate ways。强调彻底切断关系。

Definition (EN): to feel or show the same way about something, more strongly
Example Sentence: If you hate that film, it goes double for me.
例句翻译: 你要是讨厌那部电影，我更讨厌。
Usage Note: 口语，指感受完全一致；常用 It goes double for me 表示强烈赞同或反感。

Definition (EN): unfinished matters needing attention
台词翻译: 我们这边还有尾巴没处理！
Example Sentence: A few loose ends before we sign off.
例句翻译: 签字之前还有几件收尾的事。
Usage Note: 固定用复数。tie up loose ends=收尾；at loose ends=茫然无措。

Definition (EN): to say you are ill and will not come to work or school
Quote from Episode: Ditch it, man, call in sick.
Example Sentence: He called in sick and went to the beach instead.
例句翻译: 他请了病假，结果去了海滩。
Usage Note: 搭配 call in sick / call in sick leave。名词 sick leave=病假。

Definition (EN): to refuse or reject something
Quote from Episode: has to go through all these photos and turn them down
台词翻译: 得把这些照片全过一遍并退回去。
Example Sentence: The committee turned down our proposal again.
例句翻译: 委员会又一次否决了我们的提案。
Usage Note: 也指调低音量 turn it down；此处是被拒绝。

Definition (EN): a bra
Quote from Episode: some new type of brassiere, or something
台词翻译: 说是出了种新型胸罩什么的。
Example Sentence: Brassiere sizing changed for the first time in decades.
例句翻译: 胸罩尺码几十年来第一次改变。
Usage Note: 美式拼 brassiere(不重音 re)，英式 bra 更常用；是 school health 教材里的正式词。

Definition (EN): to listen closely to something
Quote from Episode: I went and put my ear to the RV
台词翻译: 我凑到房车那儿听了听。
Example Sentence: She put her ear to the door and listened.
例句翻译: 她把耳朵贴到门上听着。
Usage Note: put your ear to something＝凑近听；ear to the ground＝倾听消息。

Definition (EN): to escape from confinement
Quote from Episode: I think he's trying to get loose.
Example Sentence: The horse got loose and bolted.
例句翻译: 马挣脱了缰绳跑了。
Usage Note: 此义指挣脱束缚；lose/loose 一字之差。

Definition (EN): to panic or become very agitated
Example Sentence: Don't freak out, it's only a scratch.
例句翻译: 别慌，只是一道划痕。
Usage Note: 比 panic 程度低；freak someone out=吓到某人。

Definition (EN): to spring suddenly on a target
Example Sentence: The cat pounced on the mouse.
例句翻译: 猫猛地扑向老鼠。
Usage Note: 字面猫扑 prey；引申为抓住时机突袭。

Definition (EN): to wait patiently for the right moment
Quote from Episode: I would just lie back down, and bide my time.
台词翻译: 我就重新躺下，耐心等时机。
Example Sentence: He bided his time until the right moment.
例句翻译: 他耐心等待合适的时机。
Usage Note: 正式/书面；bide one's time 与 wait one's turn 不同，指等待良机。

Definition (EN): completely unconscious
台词翻译: 因为他当时昏死过去了。
Example Sentence: The boxer left his opponent out cold.
例句翻译: 拳击手把对手打得昏了过去。
Usage Note: 只用于失去意识，不能用于睡着（asleep）。knock out cold 更强。

Definition (EN): requires action now
Quote from Episode: This isn't even the issue that demands immediate attention
台词翻译: 这甚至都不是那个需要马上处理的问题。
Example Sentence: The leak demands immediate attention.
例句翻译: 泄漏问题必须立刻处理。
Usage Note: 书面语；demand 作动词时「要求」用复数 demands 表示单数主语。

Definition (EN): behaviour considered impolite or wrong
Quote from Episode: I don't suppose it is bad form to just flip a coin
台词翻译: 抛硬币决定大概不算失礼吧。
Example Sentence: It was bad form to leave without saying goodbye.
例句翻译: 不告而别很失礼。
Usage Note: 英式较常见；it is bad form to do sth＝做某事有失体面。

Definition (EN): weak and easily broken; unconvincing
释义（中文）: 薄而不结实的；站不住脚的
台词翻译: 这塑料摸起来挺不结实。
Example Sentence: That's a flimsy excuse and we both know it.
例句翻译: 那个借口很站不住脚，我们俩都清楚。
Usage Note: 既形容物理脆弱，也形容论点/借口无力。 flimsy alibi=站不住脚的不在场证明。

Definition (EN): to eat away at something until it is destroyed
Quote from Episode: Any decent acid's gonna eat right through this.
台词翻译: 随便什么像样的酸都能把这腐蚀穿。
Example Sentence: Rust ate through the pipe in a year.
例句翻译: 锈一年内就把管子蛀穿了。
Usage Note: 此处是被强酸穿透；eat into＝逐渐侵蚀。

Definition (EN): to be needlessly unpleasant about a refusal
释义（中文）: 因为被拒绝就摆臭脸；小气
Example Sentence: Don't be a dick about it, it was a mistake.
例句翻译: 别为这点事摆脸色，那是失误。
Usage Note: 粗俗但常用；dick=混蛋，与生理义无关。名词 a dick=讨厌的人。

Definition (EN): to gradually bring yourself to do something unpleasant
释义（中文）: 鼓起勇气去做（不想做的事）
Example Sentence: He worked up to asking for a raise.
例句翻译: 他鼓起勇气去要求加薪。
Usage Note: 强调心理上的逐步准备；work up the courage to do sth 同义。

Definition (EN): someone exhausted and disengaged from their usual life
Quote from Episode: this big secret you seem to be discussing with some druggie burn-out
台词翻译: 你在跟一个嗑药的废物讨论什么大秘密。
Example Sentence: The company is full of quiet burn-outs.
例句翻译: 公司里到处都是 quietly 倦怠的人。
Usage Note: burnout=职业倦怠(不可数)；a burn-out 指人(可数)。

Definition (EN): to make sense; to be the logical result
Quote from Episode: the whole thing adds up to
台词翻译: 这么看整件事就说得通了。
Example Sentence: The numbers don't add up to a real motive.
例句翻译: 这些数字凑不出一个真实的动机。
Usage Note: add up to 还有「总计」义；此处指讲得通。

Definition (EN): short by an amount
Example Sentence: We're two hundred dollars shy of the target.
例句翻译: 我们离目标还差两百块。
Usage Note: shy of=差…；此处接数字，与害羞无关。

Definition (EN): the raised arch of the foot
Quote from Episode: My arches happen to be extremely archy.
台词翻译: 我的脚弓那叫一个厉害。
Example Sentence: Flat feet mean the arches do not support you.
例句翻译: 扁平足意味着足弓无法支撑身体。
Usage Note: 原文是俏皮话 extremely archy（在 arches 上玩梗），可学的词只有 arches。

Definition (EN): to stop and reconsider before continuing
Example Sentence: Let me back up and start again.
例句翻译: 我打住重头说一遍。
Usage Note: 口语：讲着讲着修正自己；backup a plan=另做打算。

Definition (EN): used to swear that something is true
Quote from Episode: Right hand to God, Walter Jr.
台词翻译: 我对天发誓，小沃尔特他……
Example Sentence: Right hand to God, I didn't take it.
例句翻译: 我对天发誓，不是我拿的。
Usage Note: 较老式的强调语；现在多说 I swear to God。

Word / Phrase: not as far as I know
Definition (EN): based on the little information I have
Quote from Episode: Certainly not as far as I know.
Example Sentence: He never lies, not as far as I know.
例句翻译: 据我所知他从不撒谎。
Usage Note: as far as I know 是日常限定的固定说法，暗示自己并不完全确定。

Definition (EN): humiliating; losing one's dignity
Example Sentence: He considers the uniform degrading.
例句翻译: 他觉得穿那身制服有失身份。
Usage Note: 既指人格受辱，也指物理磨损；动词 degrade。

Definition (EN): a surprising piece of news
Quote from Episode: This shouldn't come across as some news flash.
台词翻译: 这不该算什么劲爆消息吧。
Example Sentence: Don't treat my leaving like a news flash.
例句翻译: 别把我走当成什么大新闻。
Usage Note: 源自广播新闻快讯；作「这没什么大不了」时带贬义。

Definition (EN): killing without any emotion or mercy
Quote from Episode: if it's between that and cold-blooded murder
台词翻译: 如果非要在放我和冷血谋杀之间选。
Example Sentence: He was convicted of cold-blooded murder.
例句翻译: 他被判冷血谋杀罪。
Usage Note: 固定搭配；warm-blooded 形容词指「热血的」，与之相反。

Definition (EN): to defecate
Quote from Episode: I'm trying to pinch one off in here!
Example Sentence: Tell him I'm pinching one off, then talk to me.
例句翻译: 就说我在拉屎，然后让他来找我。
Usage Note: 极粗俗；pinch/squeeze/take a crap 同义，正式场合完全不能用。

Definition (EN): to stop a flow by squeezing it shut
Example Sentence: Pinch the hose off and let the tank drain.
例句翻译: 捏住软管让水箱排空。
Usage Note: 此处字面掐断管子，Jesse 借的双关；pinch off a valve 是机械术语。

Word / Phrase: this is going down the toilet
Definition (EN): is being wasted or destroyed
Quote from Episode: This is going down the toilet.
Example Sentence: Another week like that and we're going down the toilet.
例句翻译: 再来一周这样我们厂就完了。
Usage Note: down the toilet 是习语，泛指彻底报废、浪费。

Definition (EN): to be what someone has managed to achieve
Example Sentence: A four-hour cleanup. That is your contribution.
例句翻译: 收拾了四个小时。就这？
Usage Note: 反讽用法：字面是「贡献」，实则指糟糕的结果。

Definition (EN): the smell of sweaty feet
Quote from Episode: My whole house smells like toe cheese and dry cleaning.
台词翻译: 我整间屋子都是脚臭味和干洗店味。
Example Sentence: The gym smells like toe cheese.
例句翻译: 健身房闻起来像脚臭。
Usage Note: toe cheese=脚趾间真菌感染的俗称；也指闻起来像奶酪的脚。

Definition (EN): declare a random tie-breaker binding
释义（中文）: 抛硬币的结果神圣不可违
Example Sentence: We agreed. Coin flip is sacred. Now go.
例句翻译: 说好了。抛硬币神圣，现在去干活。
Usage Note: sacred 意为不可侵犯；呼应 Walt 用抛硬币推卸责任的诡辩。

Definition (EN): to restate a figure in today's money
Quote from Episode: adjusting for inflation say, $45,000 a year
台词翻译: 按通胀折算，一年大概四万五。
Example Sentence: The salary looks impressive until you adjust for inflation.
例句翻译: 按通胀折算后这份薪水就没那么诱人了。
Usage Note: 财经必备；inflation-adjusted real terms＝实际（不变价）口径。

Definition (EN): HELOC: a credit line secured against the house
Example Sentence: They tapped the home equity line to cover the renovation.
例句翻译: 他们动用房屋净值额度付装修款。
Usage Note: 缩写 HELOC。在美国是常见的高息借贷来源。

Definition (EN): a long-term loan secured against property
Example Sentence: They paid off the mortgage five years early.
例句翻译: 他们提前五年还清了房贷。
Usage Note: 英式常拼 mortgage，美式同理；动词 mortgage＝抵押。

Definition (EN): the average cost of basic living
Quote from Episode: Cost of living, food, clothing, utilities
Example Sentence: Their offer doesn't cover the cost of living here.
例句翻译: 他们的报价不够覆盖这里的生活成本。
Usage Note: = COL。动词搭配 cost of living index＝生活成本指数。

Definition (EN): water, gas, electricity and similar household services
Quote from Episode: Cost of living, food, clothing, utilities
Example Sentence: The utilities alone run four hundred a month here.
例句翻译: 光水电费这里一个月就要四百。
Usage Note: 永远用复数；单数 utility 指「有用、公用事业」。

Definition (EN): to be beaten up badly
Quote from Episode: You can't take an ass-beating, bitch?
Example Sentence: He took an ass-beating and still wouldn't talk.
例句翻译: 他挨了顿毒打还是不肯说。
Usage Note: 粗俗。ass-beating＝打在屁股上的揍，引申为痛打。

Definition (EN): vultures and scavengers circling
释义（中文）: 秃鹫老鼠那一套（趁火打劫的人）
Quote from Episode: Buzzards and rats and all that.
Example Sentence: Leave before the buzzards and rats circle.
例句翻译: 趁秃鹫老鼠还没围上来赶紧走。
Usage Note: 江湖说法，比喻趁乱捞好处的人。

Definition (EN): to come across as making excuses
Example Sentence: His explanation sounded like arguing from the start.
例句翻译: 他的解释从头听起来就是在狡辩。
Usage Note: sound like + 名词＝听起来像…。职场申辩场景高频。

Definition (EN): an exaggerated urgency
释义（中文）: 急什么；有什么大不了的
Example Sentence: Calm down. What's the big hurry?
例句翻译: 别急，急什么。
Usage Note: 常用于反问对方不必要的慌张。

Definition (EN): a mess on one's face
Quote from Episode: I've got all this crap on my face
Example Sentence: He had blood crap on his face and didn't notice.
例句翻译: 他脸上沾着血污，自己都没发现。
Usage Note: crap＝脏东西（不可数）。也可作动词：crap out＝失败。

Definition (EN): to warm food up
Quote from Episode: Do you want me to heat some up for you?
Example Sentence: I'll heat it up, be ready in five.
例句翻译: 我热一下，五分钟后好。
Usage Note: 口语固定搭配，热菜不是重新做。

Definition (EN): to adjust to new conditions
Quote from Episode: they can occasionally adapt to other local areas
台词翻译: 它们偶尔也能适应其他本地场景。
Example Sentence: The model adapts to local speech patterns.
例句翻译: 模型能适应本地的说话习惯。
Usage Note: adapt to 后接名词；adapt sth to sth＝使某物适应。adaptation 名。

Definition (EN): to direct your frustration at someone
Quote from Episode: you cannot take it out on me
Example Sentence: He took his bad day out on the whole team.
例句翻译: 他把一天的火气发在全队身上。
Usage Note: 情绪管理场景。反义 keep it to yourself。

Definition (EN): a guess based on little evidence
Example Sentence: The whole report is conjecture dressed as analysis.
例句翻译: 整份报告是把猜测包装成分析。
Usage Note: 正式；动词 conjecture＝推测。speculation 的近义词。

Definition (EN): silence on an open line or empty broadcast
Quote from Episode: Dead air, hang ups every time.
台词翻译: 都是无人接听，每次都挂断。
Example Sentence: Thirty seconds of dead air killed the joke.
例句翻译: 三十秒的冷场把笑点毁了。
Usage Note: 电视行业也指节目无内容播出。字面「死掉的空气」。

Definition (EN): driving around with no particular destination
Quote from Episode: I saw that Caddy of his cruising my neighbourhood
台词翻译: 我看见他那辆凯迪在我这片晃荡。
Example Sentence: He cruises past the house every night.
例句翻译: 他每天晚上都在这附近晃。
Usage Note: cruise＝兜风；名词 a cruise＝一次航行。驾照上的 status 常写 single。

Definition (EN): the past action that did not happen
Quote from Episode: If he wanted to kill us, he would've at the junkyard.
台词翻译: 他要真想杀我们，在废车场就动手了。
Example Sentence: If she'd read the contract she would have known.
例句翻译: 她要是读了合同就知道了。
Usage Note: 英语第三类虚拟条件句；与 should have（当初该做而没做）区分。

Definition (EN): to hit someone repeatedly until they die
Quote from Episode: Did you not see him beat a dude to death for, like, nothing?
台词翻译: 你没看见他为了屁大点事把人活活打死吗？
Example Sentence: They beat him to death in the stairwell.
例句翻译: 他们在楼梯间把他打死了。
Usage Note: be beaten to death＝被群殴致死。反义 beat to 胜出。

Definition (EN): a gang or entourage
Example Sentence: The senator arrived with her usual posse.
例句翻译: 参议员带着她惯有的随从来了。
Usage Note: 原义「骑兵小队」，现指跟班团伙。

Definition (EN): one small stage at a time
Quote from Episode: Specifically, how would you do it? Step by step.
Example Sentence: We migrate step by step rather than in one release.
例句翻译: 我们一步步迁移，而不是一次性上线。
Usage Note: 职场拆解任务的标准说法。名词 step-by-step。

Definition (EN): to deliver a new lot of product
Quote from Episode: Every time we bring in a new batch
台词翻译: 每次我们进一批新货的时候……
Example Sentence: They bring in a fresh batch every fortnight.
例句翻译: 他们每两周进一批新货。
Usage Note: 此处是毒品贩运行话；零售也可用（batch＝一批）。

Definition (EN): an act of inhaling drugs
Example Sentence: He took a long snort and passed it on.
例句翻译: 他狠狠吸了一口就递给别人。
Usage Note: 俚语；动词 snort＝响鼻、哼声。

Definition (EN): to shelve a topic for now
Quote from Episode: All right, we'll put a pin in that.
Example Sentence: Put a pin in it and we'll come back to it Monday.
例句翻译: 先放一放，周一我们再回来谈。
Usage Note: 来自把图钉在地图上标记。职场高频＝暂停议题。

Definition (EN): to approach you aggressively
Quote from Episode: he's probably coming at you, right?
Example Sentence: Audit's coming at you on Thursday.
例句翻译: 审计周四要找上你了。
Usage Note: 含敌意。come at＝攻击／质问。

Definition (EN): to turn to confront someone
Example Sentence: She wheeled on him and demanded an answer.
例句翻译: 她转过身来直接质问他。
Usage Note: 口语；名词 wheel＝方向盘。

Definition (EN): getting close to empty
Example Sentence: We're running low on budget for this sprint.
例句翻译: 这个 sprint 的预算快用完了。
Usage Note: run low on sth＝不够用。反义 well stocked。

Definition (EN): someone who gets up early
Quote from Episode: aren't you early bird, up and out already?
台词翻译: 你这只早起鸟，都出门了？
Example Sentence: She's an early bird and starts before seven.
例句翻译: 她是早起派，七点前就开始。
Usage Note: 也指「早到的人／先动手的人」。反义 night owl。

Definition (EN): a big, usually affable man
Quote from Episode: The big lug and I are gonna go
台词翻译: 我和我那大块头兄弟要去……
Example Sentence: Me and the big lug are heading to the game.
例句翻译: 我和我那大块头要去看球。
Usage Note: lug＝大而无当的人；语气亲昵。近义 lump。

Definition (EN): the jargon of a group
Example Sentence: Six months in and she already knows the lingo.
例句翻译: 进来半年她已经懂行话了。
Usage Note: 指特定圈子的说法。近义 jargon。

Definition (EN): a charge for breaking a term
Quote from Episode: They were gonna charge us a penalty
台词翻译: 他们本来要收我们违约金。
Example Sentence: Cancelling inside 30 days triggers a penalty.
例句翻译: 30 天内取消会触发违约金。
Usage Note: 合同条款常用词。反义 waived（被豁免的）。

Definition (EN): at the final moment
Quote from Episode: Remember how at the last minute they changed it?
台词翻译: 还记得最后一刻他们改的吗？
Example Sentence: They approved the budget at the last minute.
例句翻译: 他们在最后一刻批了预算。
Usage Note: 固定搭配；= at the last moment。反义 at short notice。

Definition (EN): to delay someone leaving
Example Sentence: Wait up, I still need my keys.
例句翻译: 等等我，我还要找钥匙。
Usage Note: 指让人等一下。反义 push on（继续走）。

Definition (EN): out of bed and about the day
Example Sentence: He's up and out by seven every day.
例句翻译: 他每天七点就起床出门。
Usage Note: up and out＝起床并外出（英式略旧）。反义 stay in。

Definition (EN): to cultivate someone or something over time
台词翻译: （投行）里到处都是花钱培养平庸人才的人
Example Sentence: She nurtured a side project into a real business.
例句翻译: 她把一个业余项目慢慢做成了正经生意。
Usage Note: 比 raise 更书面。名词 nurture 指教养/培养。

Definition (EN): small improvements that accumulate
台词翻译: 这是一门靠边际收益吃饭的生意
Example Sentence: The company improved margins through marginal gains.
例句翻译: 公司靠一点点的边际提升提高了利润率。
Usage Note: 衍生 marginal＝边缘的/微小的；也指人口边缘群体（marginalized）。

Definition (EN): an unofficial or unfair route into a job
Quote from Episode: Nothing wrong with the back door.
Example Sentence: He got in through the back door of a family connection.
例句翻译: 他靠家族关系走了后门进去。
Usage Note: 职场还指「非标准渠道获客」。走正门是 through the front door。

Definition (EN): to take a subordinate role
Quote from Episode: I played third fiddle to two
台词翻译: 我在我母亲生命里那两个大人物面前只能屈居第三
Example Sentence: She's been playing third fiddle in the partnership.
例句翻译: 她在合伙关系里一直当配角。
Usage Note: 源自小提琴三把中的第三把（最低音）。

Definition (EN): a system where advancement is based on ability
Quote from Episode: thing to a meritocracy there is.
台词翻译: 这已经是这世上最接近能力至上的东西了
Example Sentence: The company has a reputation for being a meritocracy.
例句翻译: 这家公司以任人唯贤著称。
Usage Note: 形容词 meritocratic；讽刺用法指「其实看关系」。

Definition (EN): based on; relying on the evidence of
Quote from Episode: on the strength of my abilities.
Example Sentence: He was hired on the strength of his internship.
例句翻译: 他是凭实习表现被招进来的。
Usage Note: 强调「以此为依据」，也可指某个具体事件促成某结果。

Definition (EN): a school or candidate a firm does not normally recruit from
Example Sentence: Recruiting dropped to zero at the nontarget schools.
例句翻译: 非目标学校的招聘归零了。
Usage Note: 咨询/投行术语。反义 target school。名词作形容词用。

Definition (EN): an onboarding programme for new staff
台词翻译: 你们第三周的入职培训
Example Sentence: Induction runs for three days.
例句翻译: 入职培训为期三天。
Usage Note: 英式常用，美式多说 onboarding/orientation。动词 induct=使就职。

Definition (EN): to teach someone a doctrine insistently
Example Sentence: They indoctrinated him into the company culture.
例句翻译: 他们给他灌输了公司文化。
Usage Note: 强贬义，指不加批判的灌输。名词 indoctrination。

Definition (EN): still displaying an obvious marker of your background
释义（中文）: 还挂着标签（出身/身份一眼可见）
Quote from Episode: label on your sleeve there as well?
台词翻译: 你也把袖口的标签留着呢？
Example Sentence: New hires shouldn't wear their old job on their sleeve.
例句翻译: 新人不该把上一份工作的标签随身带着。
Usage Note: 字面裁缝留的布标；引申为「一眼看出底细」。

Definition (EN): lacking social grace; tacteless
Example Sentence: Saying that out loud was gauche.
例句翻译: 把那句话当众说出来很不得体。
Usage Note: 读 /ɡoʊʃ/，结尾不发 /k/。名词 gaucherie＝笨拙。

Definition (EN): to display something embarrassingly obvious about yourself
释义（中文）: 竖起自己的广告牌（把自己标出来）
台词翻译: 你刚才那举动等于给自己竖了块广告牌
Example Sentence: Don't erect a billboard around your own weaknesses.
例句翻译: 别把自己的弱点举着牌到处走。
Usage Note: 比喻用法：主动暴露自己。erect 在这里是竖立。

Definition (EN): to promise that someone's word can be trusted
台词翻译: 哪位资深员工为你背书
Example Sentence: I'll vouch for her with my manager.
例句翻译: 我会向经理替她担保。
Usage Note: 正式语体。反义 vouch against（说某人坏话）。

Definition (EN): Reduction in Force: large-scale redundancies
台词翻译: 就是 Reduction in Force，也就是裁员
Example Sentence: Every department is anxious before RIF season.
例句翻译: 裁员季前每个部门都心惊胆战。
Usage Note: 美式委婉说法；英式多用 redundancy / make redundant。拼写没有 U。

Definition (EN): ranking above all others in importance
台词翻译: 全球首屈一指的金融服务机构
Example Sentence: She is the preeminent scholar in the field.
例句翻译: 她是该领域最杰出的学者。
Usage Note: 正式书面语，日常用 leading / foremost。副词 preeminently。

Definition (EN): a personal financial or emotional interest in the outcome
Quote from Episode: like you have a stake in it.
台词翻译: 就当你自己有份利益在里面那样行事
Example Sentence: Employees behave differently when they have a stake in it.
例句翻译: 当切身利益在里面时，员工表现就不同了。
Usage Note: have a stake in＝有份利益在…；at stake＝处于危险中。

Definition (EN): too important to be replaced
Example Sentence: He made himself indispensable to the team.
例句翻译: 他让自己成了团队里无可替代的人。
Usage Note: 反义 dispensable（可有可无的）；动词 dispense with＝免除。

Definition (EN): profitable trading; revenue
Quote from Episode: We want to get you printing
台词翻译: 我们希望你尽快开始创收
Example Sentence: She's been printing business since her first quarter.
例句翻译: 她入行第一个季度就开始创收了。
Usage Note: 投行/交易行话；print money＝轻松赚钱。

Definition (EN): to disclose your trades to a supervisor
Example Sentence: Analysts must talk their book before taking a position.
例句翻译: 分析师建仓前必须报备自己的交易。
Usage Note: 投行/券商行话：book＝账本/持仓簿。

Definition (EN): to fill someone's inbox with unwanted email
Quote from Episode: Sorry, I didn't want to clog your inbox.
台词翻译: 抱歉，我不想塞满你的收件箱。
Example Sentence: The alerts clog my inbox every morning.
例句翻译: 这些提醒每天早上塞满我的收件箱。
Usage Note: 职场抱怨句式：I don't want to add to your plate（不想给你添活）。

Definition (EN): low-probability but catastrophic risk
释义（中文）: 尾部风险（小概率巨灾风险）
Quote from Episode: tail risk work you did for him.
台词翻译: 你给他做的美国尾部风险工作让他印象深刻
Example Sentence: The model measures tail risk under stress scenarios.
例句翻译: 模型衡量压力情景下的尾部风险。
Usage Note: 金融术语，指分布末端的极端风险；headline risk 指最坏预期。

Definition (EN): to archive a position or record
Example Sentence: He cycled in his notes after the meeting.
例句翻译: 会后他把记录归档了。
Usage Note: 会计/金融用语，指把账面结清归档。也可说 cycled out（退出）。

Definition (EN): the other party in a financial transaction
Example Sentence: The bank cleared once both counterparties signed.
例句翻译: 双方对手方签字后清算就完成了。
Usage Note: 金融法律术语。counterparty risk＝对手方风险。

Definition (EN): to manipulate a price or result dishonestly
Example Sentence: They rigged the auction so their client won.
例句翻译: 他们操纵了拍卖让自己客户中标。
Usage Note: rig the market／rig an auction。名词 a rig＝ rigged 装置／钻井平台。

Definition (EN): to become less aggressive
台词翻译: 我在这件事上要做正人君子，缓和一下语气。
Example Sentence: He apologized and lowered the tone immediately.
例句翻译: 他道了歉，马上就缓和了语气。
Usage Note: 职场冲突降级说法。反义 raise the tone／heat things up。

Definition (EN): someone good at social talk
台词翻译: 做交际花不是什么倒退的事。
Example Sentence: She is a brilliant conversationalist with clients.
例句翻译: 她跟客户打交道非常健谈。
Usage Note: 职场社交技能说法。反义 taciturn（沉默寡言的）。

Definition (EN): to start eating eagerly
Example Sentence: The food was cold, but we dug in anyway.
例句翻译: 饭菜是凉的，但我们还是吃了。
Usage Note: 字面「挖进去」；引申为投入地开始做事（dig into a problem）。

Definition (EN): mature and serious, as opposed to childish
Example Sentence: We need a grown-up conversation about scope.
例句翻译: 我们需要一次关于范围的成熟对话。
Usage Note: 名词 grown-up＝成年人。职场指「按规矩来」。

Definition (EN): including the unflattering parts
释义（中文）: 不加掩饰的；连缺点一起
台词翻译: 他们要做一期不加粉饰的曝光报道。
Example Sentence: His biography is a warts-and-all account.
例句翻译: 他的传记毫不掩饰地写了所有事。
Usage Note: 固定搭配。反义 sanitised（被美化的）。

Definition (EN): a revealing account, usually investigative
台词翻译: 一期针对 Pierpoint 的深度曝光。
Example Sentence: The paper ran an exposé on the bank's lending.
例句翻译: 报纸做了一篇针对该银行放贷的曝光报道。
Usage Note: 法语借词，重音在末尾。形容词 exposé 的。

Definition (EN): committed to two things at the same time
台词翻译: 我的一个客户和你们的人撞了时间。
Example Sentence: The MD is double-booked at three o'clock.
例句翻译: MD 三点同时有两场会。
Usage Note: 职场高频。名词 a double-booking＝撞档。

Definition (EN): to smooth over a snag
释义（中文）: 把疙瘩理顺；解决小麻烦
Quote from Episode: I just want to iron out the kink
台词翻译: 我只想把那个小疙瘩理顺。
Example Sentence: Let's iron out the kinks before it goes to committee.
例句翻译: 在提交委员会之前我们把细节理顺。
Usage Note: kink 原义「接头处的弯折」，引申为不顺畅之处。

Definition (EN): a vague label to disguise what is really happening
Example Sentence: Don't let them call this a growth initiative — call it a salad yield.
例句翻译: 别让他们把这叫「增长计划」，就叫「沙拉收益」吧。
Usage Note: 职场讽刺用语：用一个模糊名词掩盖实情（源自股票投资午餐会）。

Definition (EN): to expose someone as a fraud
Example Sentence: One of them outed the whole scheme in the meeting.
例句翻译: 其中一个人在会上把整个套路揭穿了。
Usage Note: 指揭穿内幕或谎言。out＝揭发。

Definition (EN): to sit down
Example Sentence: Pull up a pew, the briefing starts in five.
例句翻译: 坐吧，简报五分钟后开始。
Usage Note: pew＝教堂长椅。办公室里的幽默借词。

Definition (EN): approval or tacit permission from someone senior
Example Sentence: He won't sign off without the CFO's blessing.
例句翻译: 没有 CFO 点头他不会批。
Usage Note: 职场委婉说法：give／get the blessing。反义 curse。

Definition (EN): the number of people an organisation employs
台词翻译: 上季度我们冻结了编制。
Example Sentence: A hiring freeze means headcount stays flat.
例句翻译: 招聘冻结意味着编制不增。
Usage Note: HR 术语。freeze／cut headcount＝冻结／削减编制。

Definition (EN): the currency trading market
Example Sentence: FX desks trade Foreign Exchange on a global scale.
例句翻译: 外汇交易台在全球范围做外汇。
Usage Note: 缩写 FX；也指「换汇」这个动作。

Definition (EN): someone doing something unskilfully
Example Sentence: Calling that a hedge was amateur.
例句翻译: 把那个叫对冲是外行话。
Usage Note: 字面业余爱好者；此处是贬义。反义 professional。

Definition (EN): a secret plan among a group
台词翻译: 最好的友谊都始于一场共谋。
Example Sentence: Their whole alliance grew out of a conspiracy of favours.
例句翻译: 他们的联盟始于一场互相帮衬的共谋。
Usage Note: conspirator＝同谋。职场暗示利益交换的小圈子。

Definition (EN): a team of traders
Example Sentence: She moved from the FX desk to credit.
例句翻译: 她从外汇台调到了信贷。
Usage Note: 投行术语。desk＝一个业务单元，不指桌子。

Definition (EN): as a professional-development gesture
释义（中文）: 为了让你成长（职场话术）
Quote from Episode: This is for your growth, okay?
台词翻译: 这是为了你的成长，好吗。
Example Sentence: They promised the move was for growth, not politics.
例句翻译: 他们说这次调动是为了成长，不是政治。
Usage Note: 职场包装语；常与 for the business 相对，指个人利益。

Definition (EN): to reserve a time or a place
Example Sentence: She's double-booked for Thursday afternoon.
例句翻译: 她周四下午撞了两个约。
Usage Note: 职场撞会说法。book out＝订满。

Definition (EN): to refuse to discuss something
Example Sentence: They said they can't talk about it until the deal closes.
例句翻译: 他们说成交前不便透露。
Usage Note: 职场婉拒的标准说法。at the moment＝目前。

Definition (EN): to be exhausted; to run out of a supply
台词翻译: 在他们那套说法用完之前别谈生意。
Example Sentence: He always opens with flattery until it runs out.
例句翻译: 他总是先恭维到你听腻为止。
Usage Note: run out of／until it runs out＝用完。

Definition (EN): operating and working properly
Example Sentence: The new billing service has been up and running since Tuesday.
例句翻译: 新的计费服务周二就上线了。
Usage Note: 科技/职场高频。get something up and running＝把它跑起来。

Definition (EN): to disturb an established industry from outside it
释义（中文）: 颠覆；用新方式冲击传统行业
Example Sentence: Startups are disrupting the whole payments sector.
例句翻译: 初创公司正在颠覆整个支付行业。
Usage Note: 源自 disruption theory（以新技术取代旧产业）。名词 disruption。

Definition (EN): to present an idea to persuade someone to back it
Quote from Episode: when you pitched me Pied Piper you said it was gonna be
台词翻译: 你当时向我推介 Pied Piper 的时候说……
Example Sentence: She pitched the idea to three investors in one afternoon.
例句翻译: 她一下午把这个想法推介给了三位投资人。
Usage Note: 名词 a pitch＝推介；也可指球场传球或音高。

Definition (EN): the point at which something takes off
Quote from Episode: once it reaches a critical mass of users
台词翻译: 一旦用户量达到临界规模
Example Sentence: The product stalled until it hit critical mass.
例句翻译: 这个产品一直不温不火，直到达到临界规模。
Usage Note: 借自物理学；平台经济常用，指用户/节点足够多后自我加速。

Definition (EN): to violate a law or right, such as a copyright
Quote from Episode: if you're infringing on any copyrighted material
台词翻译: 如果你侵犯了任何受版权保护的素材
Example Sentence: The label sued them for infringing on the song.
例句翻译: 厂牌起诉他们侵犯了歌曲版权。
Usage Note: infringe on＝侵犯。名词 infringement；形容词 infringing。

Definition (EN): to produce the results or work expected of you
Quote from Episode: if you want to live here, you've got to deliver
台词翻译: 你想住这儿就得拿出东西来。
Example Sentence: He promised a launch by Friday and delivered.
例句翻译: 他承诺周五上线，确实做到了。
Usage Note: 职场引申义＝兑现承诺。反义 fail to deliver。

Definition (EN): a person or thing that contributes nothing
Quote from Episode: I can't have dead weight at my Incubator
台词翻译: 我的孵化器里不能养闲人。
Example Sentence: Two contractors were dead weight on that project.
例句翻译: 那两个外包在项目里基本是闲人。
Usage Note: 职场评价他人常用；也指行李等多余负重。

Definition (EN): to show signs of being good at something
Quote from Episode: show some promise for fuck's sake
Example Sentence: The junior analyst shows real promise.
例句翻译: 那位初级分析师很有潜力。
Usage Note: 名词 a promise＝潜力。字面「做出承诺」是另一义。

Definition (EN): to return something to society or a community
Quote from Episode: When I sold my company, Aviato, I wanted to give back.
台词翻译: 卖掉 Aviato 后我想做点回馈。
Example Sentence: Several founders give back by funding scholarships.
例句翻译: 有几位创始人通过资助奖学金回馈社会。
Usage Note: 此处是慈善义，不是「退还」。名词 give-back。

Definition (EN): hand the mic to the next speaker
Quote from Episode: Take it away, my good friend, Kid Rock.
台词翻译: 交给我的好兄弟 Kid Rock 吧。
Example Sentence: Great speech. I'll take it away from here.
例句翻译: 说得好，剩下的交给我。
Usage Note: 主持人口令。也可指「拿走」具体物品。

Definition (EN): stock options already earned and yours
Quote from Episode: with top pay and vested stock options
台词翻译: 顶薪加已归属的股票期权
Example Sentence: After four years her options were fully vested.
例句翻译: 四年后她的期权完全归属了。
Usage Note: 股权激励术语：vested＝已归属可兑现。名词 vesting。

Definition (EN): a meeting that achieves nothing
释义（中文）: 走过场的会；装样子的会议
Quote from Episode: the marketing team is having another bike meeting
台词翻译: 市场部又在开一个走过场的会。
Example Sentence: That was another bike meeting; nobody decided anything.
例句翻译: 又是一个走过场的会，什么都没定。
Usage Note: 源自「骑自行车」＝原地踏步。职场吐槽高频。

Definition (EN): a workplace where everyone is under the same controlling boss
Quote from Episode: inside the Gavin Belson cult compound
台词翻译: 在 Gavin Belson 那个邪教式大本营里。
Example Sentence: Two startups quit to escape the cult-compound environment.
例句翻译: 两家初创公司为了逃离那种邪教环境离职了。
Usage Note: 字面邪教总部；讽刺公司内部同质化、被老板控制。

Definition (EN): a business student who can code
Example Sentence: They hired a brogrammer to build the internal tool.
例句翻译: 他们招了个会写代码的商科生来做内部工具。
Usage Note: 由 bro（兄弟）+ programmer 拼合；也作 code bro。

Definition (EN): someone who attacks established conventions
Example Sentence: Every great product team needs one iconoclast.
例句翻译: 每个优秀的产品团队都需要一个反传统的怪才。
Usage Note: 形容词 iconoclastic。词根指「破坏偶像的人」。

Definition (EN): more people reviewing it
Quote from Episode: it's always good to have more eyes on it
Example Sentence: Let's get more eyes on this contract before signing.
例句翻译: 签之前多找几个人看看这份合同。
Usage Note: 职场常用；get eyes on＝找…评审。

Definition (EN): to produce large quantities mechanically
Quote from Episode: a system that happily churns out unemployed debtors
台词翻译: 一个源源不断产出失业负债者的系统
Example Sentence: The factory churns out two thousand units a day.
例句翻译: 这家厂每天产出两千台。
Usage Note: 含贬义，暗示机械、低质。名词 churn＝流失率（客流失）。

Definition (EN): questionable worth
Example Sentence: That certification turned out to be of dubious value.
例句翻译: 那个证书后来证明并没什么价值。
Usage Note: 形容词 dubious＝可疑的、可疑的功用。名词 dubiety。

Definition (EN): a bogus remedy or unsupported claim
释义（中文）: 江湖偏方；没有依据的说法
Quote from Episode: The true value of snake-oil is intangible as well.
台词翻译: 江湖偏方的真正价值同样是 intangible。
Example Sentence: That growth hack is just snake oil with a good deck.
例句翻译: 那个增长方法就是套了漂亮壳的江湖偏方。
Usage Note: snake-oil merchant＝骗子。snake oil＝真有疗效的蛇油，现多贬义。

Definition (EN): get ready, time is short
释义（中文）: 扣好安全带；准备好（时间不多）
Quote from Episode: You have until I fasten the seat-belt in my car.
台词翻译: 你还有时间，直到我扣上安全带。
Example Sentence: The clock is ticking — fasten your seat-belt.
例句翻译: 时间不多了，赶紧准备。
Usage Note: 职场倒计时的幽默说法；也真指系安全带。

Definition (EN): owned by a company and legally protected
Quote from Episode: Pied Piper is a proprietary site
台词翻译: Pied Piper 是个专有网站
Example Sentence: Their proprietary algorithm is the whole moat.
例句翻译: 他们的专有算法就是全部护城河。
Usage Note: 反义 open-source。名词 proprietary tech＝专有技术。

Definition (EN): losing no data in compression
台词翻译: 这个压缩是完全无损的。
Example Sentence: FLAC is a lossless format; MP3 is not.
例句翻译: FLAC 是无损格式，MP3 不是。
Usage Note: 反义 lossy（有损的），后者是日常常用词。

Definition (EN): aimed at business customers rather than end users
Quote from Episode: make it business facing and use it for enterprise
台词翻译: 把它改成 B 端，给企业用。
Example Sentence: Consumer apps are harder to monetise than business-facing tools.
例句翻译: 消费级应用比 B 端工具更难变现。
Usage Note: 对比 consumer facing＝面向终端用户。写正式商业计划书常用。

Definition (EN): a stock repeated point, often criticised
Quote from Episode: The usual riffs on twitter and instagram.
台词翻译: 推特和 insta 上那些老生常调。
Example Sentence: His set was forty minutes of riffs he'd been doing for years.
例句翻译: 他的整场演出四十分钟都是他演了好几年的老段子。
Usage Note: 原指音乐重复段落；引申为套路化的观点。动词 riff on＝就…发挥。

Definition (EN): to tease or joke with someone
Example Sentence: Don't mess with him before the presentation.
例句翻译: 汇报之前别逗他。
Usage Note: 另有一义「招惹／收拾（某人）」，看语境。

Definition (EN): to not attend or leave college
Quote from Episode: people willing to skip or drop out of college
台词翻译: 愿意退学或不上大学的人
Example Sentence: He skipped college and went straight into consulting.
例句翻译: 他退学后直接去做了咨询。
Usage Note: drop out=中途退学；skip=根本没去。两者常混用。

Definition (EN): total value of assets minus debts
Quote from Episode: there's 40 billion dollars of net worth, walking around this party
台词翻译: 这个派会上游荡着四百亿的净资产。
Example Sentence: His net worth doubled after the IPO.
例句翻译: 上市后他的净资产翻了一番。
Usage Note: 个人身家口径是资产减负债，跟「身家/估值」不同。

Definition (EN): an instruction marking the correct orientation
Example Sentence: Mark the parcel this side up and label it fragile.
例句翻译: 包裹上标「此面向上」，再贴易碎标签。
Usage Note: 物流标签语；此处在剧里被拿来调侃纹身的位置。

Definition (EN): the best, the real deal
Quote from Episode: I think Vaulter is the shiz.
台词翻译: 我觉得 Vaulter 是最正的那个。
Example Sentence: That little ramen place is the shiz.
例句翻译: 那家小拉面店才是真正的绝配。
Usage Note: shiznit 是其完整形式；1990年代末俚语。

Definition (EN): to ruin or escalate a situation
Example Sentence: He tried to fix it and blew it up even worse.
例句翻译: 他本来想补救，结果搞得更糟。
Usage Note: blow up＝炸掉；blow up at someone＝冲某人发火。

Definition (EN): the record of someone's past performance
Quote from Episode: I got a track record from founding one of the most exciting new media brands in the world.
台词翻译: 我可是创下过创办全球最激动人心的新媒体品牌之一的战绩。
Example Sentence: A clean track record matters more than a fancy degree.
例句翻译: 干净的履历比漂亮的学位更重要。
Usage Note: clean track record=无污点履历；词源本指赛马战绩。

Definition (EN): to rescue something from damage or failure
Example Sentence: They flew in to salvage the deal.
例句翻译: 他们飞过来抢救这笔交易。
Usage Note: 原指海上打捞；商业语境＝把快崩的项目救回来。

Definition (EN): the undisclosed key to a plan
Example Sentence: What's their secret sauce? Their retention is double ours.
例句翻译: 他们的秘方是什么？留存率是我们两倍。
Usage Note: 借自烹饪，指不外传的关键手法。

Definition (EN): to make a proposal more attractive, often with money
Quote from Episode: Do we need to sweeten the offer?
Example Sentence: To close the deal they sweetened the offer by 5%.
例句翻译: 为了成交他们把报价加了 5%。
Usage Note: 收购/谈判术语。

Definition (EN): to raise the price or bid slightly
Quote from Episode: You wanna bump the offer another point?
Example Sentence: We'll bump the offer to 130 and see if they blink.
例句翻译: 我们把出价提到 130，看他们急不急。
Usage Note: bump 意为「轻推、抬升」。

Definition (EN): to move slightly; to give way
Quote from Episode: They're not gonna budge unless it gets to be a stupid number.
台词翻译: 不到那个荒唐的数，他们不会松口。
Example Sentence: Neither side would budge on the price.
例句翻译: 双方在价格上谁都不肯让步。
Usage Note: budge 不 budge＝不让步；固定用法。

Definition (EN): bad vibes; a sense of impending trouble
Quote from Episode: Ooh, right, yeah, the bad juju.
Example Sentence: Something about that office gives off bad juju.
例句翻译: 那个办公室有种说不出的邪气。
Usage Note: juju 本义「巫毒魔力」；常指气氛不祥。

Definition (EN): not suited to a role or place
Example Sentence: He's a bad fit for a people-first leadership style.
例句翻译: 他不适合以人为本的领导风格。
Usage Note: 固定搭配 be a bad fit for sth。

Definition (EN): confidential for commercial reasons
Example Sentence: The board cited commercial sensitivity to refuse disclosure.
例句翻译: 董事会以商业敏感为由拒绝披露。
Usage Note: 委婉说法，正式语体。

Definition (EN): the person in charge
Quote from Episode: You're gonna be captain of the ship soon enough.
Example Sentence: Who's the captain of the ship here?
例句翻译: 这里谁说了算？
Usage Note: 常带反讽或勉励意味。

Definition (EN): like a prison
Quote from Episode: This place was essentially a cage to me.
台词翻译: 这个地方对我来说就是个牢笼。
Example Sentence: The golden cage of a corner office.
例句翻译: 角落办公室这个镀金的牢笼。
Usage Note: golden cage 是常见的「金笼子」比喻。

Definition (EN): to stay accurate and not confuse details
台词翻译: 把每件事都记清楚，行吗？
Example Sentence: I'm going straight to the board. Keep everything straight.
例句翻译: 我直接去找董事会。把每件事都记准。
Usage Note: straight 此处是「准确、不含糊」。

Definition (EN): a tropical-themed bar; mock 1970s slang
Quote from Episode: We were the pool boys, right, Frank? Fuckin' banana cabana?
台词翻译: 我们以前是泳池boys，对吧弗兰克？在那个热带酒吧。
Example Sentence: The office party was in a banana cabana.
例句翻译: 办公室派会在热带风情酒吧办的。
Usage Note: 原为 1970 年代俚语，指假热带风装修的酒吧。

Definition (EN): to have a vague, unconfirmed feeling
Quote from Episode: obviously I'm soft floating to, like, Frank and Rava
台词翻译: 我隐约听说好像跟弗兰克和拉瓦有关。
Example Sentence: I'm soft floating that they'll name someone else.
例句翻译: 我隐约觉得他们会另选人。
Usage Note: 投行俚语，指没确认的传闻。

Definition (EN): an elderly person
Quote from Episode: They stuck me in LA with Old Father Time right here.
台词翻译: 他们把我塞在洛杉矶，和老家伙一起。
Example Sentence: He's still Old Father Time even after retirement.
例句翻译: 就算退了休他还是老家伙一个。
Usage Note: 带戏谑意味。

Definition (EN): a short absence granted for emotional exhaustion
Example Sentence: She took a mental-health break after the launch went badly.
例句翻译: 发布搞砸之后她请了个心理健康假。
Usage Note: 职场委婉说法，通常指当天请假回家躺着。

Definition (EN): to write something down quickly and briefly
Quote from Episode: I will just jot that down, then.
Example Sentence: Jot down the client's name before you hang up.
例句翻译: 挂电话前先把客户名字记下来。
Usage Note: jot 是速记；名词 a jot=一点点（not a jot of）。

Definition (EN): patronising; talking down to someone
Quote from Episode: it might sound a little condescending
台词翻译: 听起来可能有点居高临下。
Example Sentence: Don't be condescending to junior staff.
例句翻译: 别用说教的口吻跟新人说话。
Usage Note: 常含冒犯意味。反义 deferential（恭敬的）。

Definition (EN): completely ordinary and unremarkable
Quote from Episode: This is your garden variety generic decongestant.
台词翻译: 这就是最普通不过的通用型鼻塞药。
Example Sentence: Don't expect garden variety service here.
例句翻译: 别指望这儿的服务是普通水平。
Usage Note: 字面「花园品种（常见品种）」，引申为最平凡不过的。

Definition (EN): someone addicted to methamphetamine
Quote from Episode: The tweakers use this to make this.
台词翻译: 那些冰鬼用这个来做这个。
Example Sentence: The documentary follows a former tweaker trying to get clean.
例句翻译: 这部纪录片跟拍一个想戒毒的瘾君子。
Usage Note: tweak 本义「微调」，俚语里指冰毒。tweaker 也可指一般瘾君子。

Definition (EN): a warning sign that something is wrong
Quote from Episode: That should have been a red flag, okay?
台词翻译: 那本来就该是个危险信号。
Example Sentence: Missing receipts for three items is a red flag.
例句翻译: 三件商品没有小票就是危险信号。
Usage Note: 职场面试、审计、投资都用；throw a red flag／raise red flags。

Definition (EN): use your head; think
Example Sentence: Use your noggin before you approve the refund.
例句翻译: 批退款前先动动脑子。
Usage Note: 口语。noggin＝脑袋；同义 get your head around it。

Definition (EN): someone who believes they are superior
释义（中文）: 自命不凡的人；精英分子
Example Sentence: Calling him an elitist ended the discussion.
例句翻译: 说他自命不凡，讨论就结束了。
Usage Note: 形容词 elitist；也作 a fashion elitist。

Definition (EN): to inform headquarters, usually to cause trouble
Quote from Episode: But then someone reported me to corporate.
台词翻译: 然后有人把我举报到总部了。
Example Sentence: If you report to corporate, expect an investigation.
例句翻译: 你要举报到总部，那就等着被调查吧。
Usage Note: corporate 在这里是「公司总部」这个部门，不只是形容词。

Definition (EN): to become successful in life
释义（中文）: 闯出点名堂；成就一番事业
Quote from Episode: I'm here to make something of myself.
台词翻译: 我来这儿是为了闯出点名堂。
Example Sentence: He moved abroad to make something of himself.
例句翻译: 他出国是为了闯出自己的天地。
Usage Note: 移民、励志语境高频。反义 make something of nothing（白手起家）。

Definition (EN): to start an independent life or career
Example Sentence: After the merger he spread his wings and went solo.
例句翻译: 并购之后他展翅单干了。
Usage Note: 字面鸟展翅；常用于离家独立或另立门户。

Definition (EN): to acquire knowledge through doing
Example Sentence: Nobody reads the manual; you learn as you go.
例句翻译: 没人看手册的，都是边干边学。
Usage Note: 非常高频的入门安慰。反义 learn the hard way（吃一堑长一智）。

Definition (EN): to avoid offending someone in authority
Quote from Episode: stay on the floor supervisor's good side
Example Sentence: It's worth staying on the finance team's good side.
例句翻译: 还是跟财务部搞好关系值得。
Usage Note: get on someone's good side＝讨好。职场潜规则说法。

Definition (EN): point-of-sale system; the checkout and inventory software
Example Sentence: The POS system crashed, so the line is backed up.
例句翻译: 收银系统崩了，队伍排起来了。
Usage Note: 零售/餐饮行业标准缩写。重音在 POS。

Definition (EN): to cancel a system restriction with special permission
Example Sentence: A supervisor has to override the price to honour the match.
例句翻译: 主管得越权改价才能兑现承诺。
Usage Note: 零售软件操作术语；形容词 an override＝例外许可。

Definition (EN): to postpone a decision overnight
Quote from Episode: I'm gonna go sleep on it.
Example Sentence: Never sign on the spot; sleep on it overnight.
例句翻译: 别当场签，睡一觉再说。
Usage Note: 极实用的职场建议；也可指字面睡着。

Definition (EN): to buy a lot of something in advance
Quote from Episode: This mistake is being corrected, so stock up quick!
台词翻译: 这个错误马上要改，赶紧囤货！
Example Sentence: Shoppers stocked up before the price hike.
例句翻译: 涨价前顾客都囤了货。
Usage Note: stock 也作名词「存货」；stock up on something 更地道。

Definition (EN): the retail maxim that shoppers are never at fault
Example Sentence: Customer service here really believes the customer is always right.
例句翻译: 这儿的客服真信奉「顾客永远是对的」。
Usage Note: 零售业箴言，常被反讽引用。来源有争议，常归给 Harry Gordon Selfridge。

Definition (EN): to make a mistake; to ruin something
Quote from Episode: the less screwing everything up you do, the better
台词翻译: 你少把事情搞砸点就好。
Example Sentence: Don't screw up the merge while I'm on holiday.
例句翻译: 我休假期间别把合并搞砸了。
Usage Note: 粗俗但极常用。screw up your life、screw you 都常见。

Definition (EN): to amaze or overwhelm someone
Example Sentence: The budget for that project blew my mind.
例句翻译: 那个项目的预算吓到我了。
Usage Note: mind-blowing 是形容词；mind = 理智，不是「心」。

Definition (EN): an overly cautious or dull person
Quote from Episode: I'm the stick in the mud.
Example Sentence: Call him a stick in the mud if you want, but he never breaks policy.
例句翻译: 你可以说他保守，但他从不违规。
Usage Note: 近义 wet blanket（扫兴的人）。stick-in-the-mud 作形容词。

Definition (EN): the display rack at the end of a store aisle
Quote from Episode: We need new shelf flags for the end caps
Example Sentence: End caps are rented out to suppliers for extra income.
例句翻译: 端架位置会租给供应商赚外快。
Usage Note: 零售术语；shelf flag＝货架价签。

Definition (EN): impossible to make out or detect
台词翻译: 没有可辨的伤疤或纹身。
Example Sentence: There was no discernible difference between the two drafts.
例句翻译: 两版草稿看不出差别。
Usage Note: 偏法律与正式语体；日常用 obvious / noticeable。

Definition (EN): indirectly, taking a roundabout route
Example Sentence: He answered circuitously because the truth was incriminating.
例句翻译: 他绕着回答，因为实话会害了他。
Usage Note: 形容词 circuitous＝迂回的。动词 circuit＝绕行。

Definition (EN): to act without being asked
Quote from Episode: I took the initiative upon myself to reorganize the toy section
台词翻译: 我自作主张把玩具区重新整理了一遍。
Example Sentence: She took the initiative and fixed the broken vendor list.
例句翻译: 她主动把有问题的供应商清单修了。
Usage Note: 搭配 take the initiative to do sth / on sth。近义 be proactive。

Definition (EN): to make something easier for someone
Quote from Episode: for the convenience of adult shoppers
Example Sentence: The meeting was moved for the convenience of the Tokyo office.
例句翻译: 为了方便东京办公室，会议改期了。
Usage Note: 正式语体；近义 for the sake of。名词 convenience=便利。

Definition (EN): retail radio code meaning a customer needs help
释义（中文）: 「绿码」——顾客需要协助（零售暗号）
Quote from Episode: I'm calling to report a code green in progress.
Example Sentence: Code green, aisle six, spilled product on the floor.
例句翻译: 绿码，六号通道，地上有商品洒了。
Usage Note: 零售/仓储业内部暗号，顾客听不到。类似 code blue、code 33。

Definition (EN): to mention something casually and briefly
Quote from Episode: so I'm just throwing that out there
Example Sentence: I'm only throwing that out there; no pressure.
例句翻译: 我就是随口提一句，没有压力。
Usage Note: 语气词，暗示这只是个建议，不要当结论。

Definition (EN): to pay someone to end their remaining term early
释义（中文）: 买断合同（付钱买断剩余期）
台词翻译: 我会付钱买断你合同剩下的部分。
Example Sentence: The club offered to buy him out of his deal.
例句翻译: 俱乐部提出付钱买断他的合约。
Usage Note: 职场通用：买断合同、买断股权。名词 a buyout。

Definition (EN): slightly better prepared than others
Example Sentence: They've been one step ahead on this for years.
例句翻译: 这件事他们领先好几年了。
Usage Note: 优势很小但真实；也常指「比别人先知道」。

Definition (EN): to leave a delicate situation unharmed
Quote from Episode: we got to get off the grass
Example Sentence: We should get off the grass before anyone asks questions.
例句翻译: 在有人问话之前我们得先撇清。
Usage Note: 英式习语，指勿踩红线；澳新也常用。

Definition (EN): to examine something in depth
台词翻译: 我等不及要跟你好好拆解一下了
Example Sentence: Let's unpack the numbers before we decide.
例句翻译: 定之前我们先把这几个数字拆开看。
Usage Note: 职场比喻义：拆解话题/问题。字面是拆行李。

Definition (EN): a small hit of stimulant energy
Example Sentence: I need a boost of caffeine before this call.
例句翻译: 这通电话前我需要点咖啡因。
Usage Note: a boost of＝一小份刺激；动词 boost 用法相同。

Definition (EN): to be sufficient to achieve the result
Example Sentence: An extra meeting should do the trick.
例句翻译: 再加开一次会应该能解决。
Usage Note: 固定搭配。反义 won't do the trick（不管用）。

Definition (EN): adapt to local customs when abroad
Example Sentence: When in Rome, order the tea the way they do.
例句翻译: 入乡随俗，茶就照他们的方式点。
Usage Note: 源自 when in Rome, do as the Romans do。

Definition (EN): a very small amount of something
台词翻译: 只要尝不出一丝咖啡味就行
Example Sentence: There's a hint of lemon in the sauce.
例句翻译: 酱汁里有一丝柠檬味。
Usage Note: 后接不可数名词。也作 not a hint of（完全不）。

Word / Phrase: take it back to the counter
Definition (EN): to return something to the shop
Example Sentence: If it's wrong, take it back to the counter.
例句翻译: 有问题的就拿回柜台退。
Usage Note: 零售／客服场景。字面「带回柜台」。

Definition (EN): to enter a place for the first time
Example Sentence: He never set foot in the office after the row.
例句翻译: 那次争吵之后他再没踏进过办公室。
Usage Note: never set foot in＝从未去过。字面 set foot＝落脚。

Definition (EN): and in fact worse; moreover
Example Sentence: He's inexperienced, and unqualified at that.
例句翻译: 他没经验，而且还没资历。
Usage Note: 用于加强前面的评价，暗示程度不如意。

Definition (EN): to become accustomed to something
Example Sentence: You'll get used to the time zones quickly.
例句翻译: 你很快就习惯时差了。
Usage Note: 与 used to do（过去常常）区分：to be used to + 名词/动名词。

Definition (EN): to resist or annoy those in power
释义（中文）: 跟权威对着干；整治当权者
台词翻译: 对付当权者最好的办法
Example Sentence: Workers stuck it to the man and got the pay rise.
例句翻译: 工人们跟老板较劲，最终争取到了涨薪。
Usage Note: the man＝当权者/体制。可换人：stick it to the system。

Definition (EN): to cover completely in a thick layer
台词翻译: 我不建议你们把这些浇上肉汁。
Example Sentence: Don't smother the pancakes in syrup.
例句翻译: 别把松饼浇满糖浆。
Usage Note: smother＝覆盖／使窒息（字面）。餐饮与化妆常用。

Definition (EN): to eat a very small amount
Example Sentence: He took a nibble of the sandwich and put it back.
例句翻译: 他咬了一小口三明治又放回去。
Usage Note: nibble＝小口；动词也指「小口啃」。比 bite 轻。

Definition (EN): to record or classify something as
台词翻译: 记下这次，我们第一次有分歧。
Example Sentence: Mark it down as a no and move to the next candidate.
例句翻译: 记为「否」，看下一个候选人。
Usage Note: 会议记录高频：mark it down as approved / rejected。

Definition (EN): something completely worthless
Example Sentence: The free tier is absolute garbage water.
例句翻译: 免费那个版本纯粹是垃圾。
Usage Note: 口语俚语。garbage water 单独也可指「劣质啤酒」。

Definition (EN): immediately from the very start
Example Sentence: Right off the bat we lost two of the three clients.
例句翻译: 一上来就丢了三个客户里的两个。
Usage Note: 近义 from the get-go / off the bat。强调「不需要时间」。

Definition (EN): unambiguous and easy to understand
Example Sentence: The brief was loud and clear: ship by Friday.
例句翻译: 需求很明确：周五前上线。
Usage Note: 确认收到指令时的回复。也作 as clear as day。

Definition (EN): be fairly sure something will not happen
Quote from Episode: I would not bet on that.
Example Sentence: I wouldn't bet on the deadline holding.
例句翻译: 我可不敢赌这个期限能守住。
Usage Note: bet on＝押注某事会发生；否定即「不相信」。

Definition (EN): a very large amount
Example Sentence: There's a buttload of admin before you can launch.
例句翻译: 上线前还有一大堆行政流程。
Usage Note: 粗俗但常用，近义 a ton of / loads of。

Definition (EN): relax and stop being so uptight
Example Sentence: Lose the ponytail — the first draft doesn't have to be perfect.
例句翻译: 放松点，第一稿不用完美。
Usage Note: 字面松开马尾＝别那么一本正经。反义 tied up。

Definition (EN): absolutely certain
Example Sentence: He was sure as heck going to miss the deadline.
例句翻译: 他百分之百要错过期限。
Usage Note: 口语强调，heck 是委婉的 hell。英式 also 说 as sick as a parrot。

Definition (EN): a football drill splitting players into opposing groups of seven
Example Sentence: The coach split the squad for seven on seven.
例句翻译: 教练把队伍分成两队打七对七。
Usage Note: 橄榄球术语；其他球类有 eleven-a-side。

Definition (EN): depressed and gloomy
Quote from Episode: Seems a little down in the dumps.
Example Sentence: He's been down in the dumps since he moved offices.
例句翻译: 换了办公室之后他一直情绪低落。
Usage Note: 近义 in the doldrums、blue。反义 in high spirits。

Definition (EN): to perform below one's ability
台词翻译: 他从这儿来了以后一直表现不达标。
Example Sentence: He underachieved in a team full of academy players.
例句翻译: 在全是大青训球员的队里他显得发挥失常。
Usage Note: 比 fail 委婉。反义词 overachieve。

Definition (EN): the latest news or gossip about someone
Quote from Episode: What's the buzz on Sam here?
Example Sentence: What's the buzz on the vendor shortlist?
例句翻译: 供应商入围名单有什么消息？
Usage Note: 非正式，源自 beeline。职场打听近况高频。

Definition (EN): a very short attention span (goldfish comparison)
Example Sentence: If the report has a ten-second memory, lead with the number.
例句翻译: 如果看报告的人只有十秒记忆，就先把数字放前面。
Usage Note: 来自「金鱼的记忆只有七秒」的调侃。

Definition (EN): the audacity to do something
Example Sentence: She had the nerve to push back on the CEO.
例句翻译: 她还真敢顶撞 CEO。
Usage Note: have the nerve to do sth＝竟敢做某事。反义 chicken。

Definition (EN): ceaseless and not stopping
Example Sentence: Her follow-up was relentless but effective.
例句翻译: 她的追问不留情面，但很有效。
Usage Note: 既可褒（不懈）也可贬（纠缠）。副词 relentlessly。

Definition (EN): to mess it up
台词翻译: 这是唯一能把这事搞砸的因素。
Example Sentence: One bad hire could muck it up for the whole quarter.
例句翻译: 招错一个人就能毁掉整个季度。
Usage Note: muck＝粪肥，引申为搞脏／弄糟。muck up＝搞砸。

Definition (EN): influence or power over others
Quote from Episode: most sway in the locker room?
Example Sentence: The striker has more sway than the manager thinks.
例句翻译: 前锋的影响力比教练以为的更大。
Usage Note: hold sway＝有支配力。近义 influence、clout。

Definition (EN): actively investigating something
Example Sentence: Audit's on the case again over the expense claims.
例句翻译: 审计又介入了，这次是报销单。
Usage Note: 来自 on a case。指派人查案，职场玩笑常用。

Definition (EN): to defeat them heavily
台词翻译: 你们今年早些时候赢他们赢得挺漂亮。
Example Sentence: They whipped them 4-0 on Saturday.
例句翻译: 周六他们 4:0 横扫了他们。
Usage Note: 体育口语。反义 got whipped＝被狠揍。

Definition (EN): to alter or interfere with something
Example Sentence: Don't mess with the config file while it's running.
例句翻译: 运行时别动配置文件。
Usage Note: 此处是「改动」，不是「逗」。另有「招惹」义。

Definition (EN): to adjust small things without good reason
台词翻译: 开始瞎调我们做事的方式。
Example Sentence: Stop fiddling with the layout; ship it.
例句翻译: 别再折腾排版了，发吧。
Usage Note: 隐含「改不出什么名堂」。近义 tinker with。

Definition (EN): upset and agitated
台词翻译: 要是有什么事让你们窝火
Example Sentence: Nobody wants to be the person who gets the CEO hot and bothered.
例句翻译: 没人想当那个惹恼 CEO 的人。
Usage Note: 比 angry 委婉；职场投诉/匿名箱语境常用。

Definition (EN): to leave a short written message
Quote from Episode: just go ahead and drop us a note
Example Sentence: Drop me a note when the numbers land.
例句翻译: 数字出来给我留个话。
Usage Note: 也可指「留张便条」字面。drop by=顺道来。

Definition (EN): not discouraged by setbacks
Example Sentence: Undetred by two rejections, she filed a third.
例句翻译: 两次被拒也没动摇，她又投了第三次。
Usage Note: 反义 deterred（气馁的）。动词 deter＝吓阻。

Definition (EN): progress made towards a goal
台词翻译: 我的进展大概就这么多。
Example Sentence: We're finally making headway on the backlog.
例句翻译: 积压的事终于有进展了。
Usage Note: make headway＝取得进展。不可数。

Definition (EN): a good first impression
Example Sentence: He made a solid entrance in the client interview.
例句翻译: 客户面谈里他开场表现不错。
Usage Note: 职场/演讲评价。反义 rough start。

Definition (EN): to look directly into someone's eyes
Example Sentence: He locked eyes with her across the negotiating table.
例句翻译: 他在谈判桌对面跟她对视。
Usage Note: 紧张、对峙、表白语境。反义 look away。

Definition (EN): to eat an amount equal to your own body weight
台词翻译: 熊猫吃的竹子有自身体重那么多。
Example Sentence: He ate his weight in leftover Christmas dinner.
例句翻译: 他吃掉了自身体重那么多剩下的圣诞饭。
Usage Note: 夸张手法，强调食量大。

Definition (EN): last in every metric
Quote from Episode: Sam's down in every stat since Nigeria.
台词翻译: Sam 回国以来各项数据都垫底。
Example Sentence: His team was down in every stat after the first hour.
例句翻译: 第一节过后他队各项数据都垫底。
Usage Note: stat＝统计项。体育报道固定说法。

Word / Phrase: nudge something in the right direction
Definition (EN): to help something improve slightly
释义（中文）: 朝正确方向轻轻推一把
台词翻译: 帮他们把船往对的方向推一把，好吧？
Example Sentence: We don't need a hero, just nudge the project along.
例句翻译: 我们不需要英雄，只要推动项目往前走一点。
Usage Note: nudge＝轻推。语气温和的鼓励说法。

Definition (EN): to make someone happier
Example Sentence: A team lunch cheered him up more than a bonus.
例句翻译: 一顿团队午餐比奖金更能让他开心。
Usage Note: cheer up 也可单独用作鼓励：「加油！」

Definition (EN): to continue for longer than scheduled
Quote from Episode: I think it's gonna run over though.
Example Sentence: Can you keep an eye on the clock? This is starting to run over.
例句翻译: 你盯着点表，已经开始超时了。
Usage Note: 职场高频。名词 run-over 指加时赛，也指「拖堂」。

Definition (EN): to promote and sell the products you are responsible for
释义（中文）: 推自己负责的货／饮料；完成业绩指标
Quote from Episode: I'm gonna push your drinks with Jane Fonda.
台词翻译: 我要跟简·方达一起推你那条饮料线。
Example Sentence: You'll be pushing your own brand from Monday.
例句翻译: 周一开始你得推自己的品牌。
Usage Note: push=推销/推动；drinks 在这里是「产品线」。同一句式：push your numbers（冲业绩）。

Definition (EN): the last fitting before a garment is approved
Quote from Episode: You need to do your final fitting for your gown for Friday.
台词翻译: 周五的礼服你得去做最后一次试衣。
Example Sentence: Her final fitting is scheduled for Thursday afternoon.
例句翻译: 她的最终试衣安排在周四下午。
Usage Note: fitting=试衣（动词 fit 也指合身）。final fitting 指量体裁衣的最后一关。

Definition (EN): to contact or reach someone
Quote from Episode: Chip's trying to get ahold of you.
Example Sentence: I'll get ahold of legal and loop you in.
例句翻译: 我去联系法务，然后把你拉进来。
Usage Note: ahold 是唯一正确拼法，ahold of 不能写成 a hold of。

Definition (EN): to include something subtly or covertly
Quote from Episode: we're also gonna slip in how safe carbon capture is
台词翻译: 我们也会顺带带一句碳捕集有多安全。
Example Sentence: She slipped in a mention of her new book at the end.
例句翻译: 她在结尾顺带提了一句她的新书。
Usage Note: 常见于媒体/谈判：把一个观点不动声色地塞进去。

Definition (EN): an intermediate step toward a larger goal
Quote from Episode: This is a stepping-stone for me.
Example Sentence: This gig is a stepping-stone into the industry.
例句翻译: 这份工作是我进入这个行业的跳板。
Usage Note: 字面踩着石头过河；职场指过渡性、积累性的机会。

Definition (EN): to force something awkwardly into a place it does not fit
Quote from Episode: an award-worthy shoehorning of the word "Harvard" into the conversation
台词翻译: 把「哈佛」这个词生硬塞进对话，简直能拿奖。
Example Sentence: He shoehorned three tangents into a two-minute answer.
例句翻译: 他在两分钟的回答里硬塞了三个题外话。
Usage Note: 源自马蹄铁（shoe-horn）。名词 shoehorning 也常用。

Definition (EN): to sell something, or promote an idea, aggressively
Quote from Episode: One less idiot to peddle soft news to the masses.
台词翻译: 少了一个向大众兜售软新闻的白痴。
Example Sentence: He's out there peddling a pyramid scheme.
例句翻译: 他在外面兜售传销。
Usage Note: 既指卖货，也贬指兜售观点。peddler=小贩。

Definition (EN): human-interest stories rather than hard news
释义（中文）: 软新闻（人情味故事，非硬新闻）
Quote from Episode: peddle soft news to the masses
Example Sentence: The network cut the hard news to make room for soft news.
例句翻译: 电视台砍掉硬新闻，腾出时间放软新闻。
Usage Note: 对比 hard news（时政硬新闻）。中文媒体也常用。

Definition (EN): to give someone advance information
Quote from Episode: was reportedly tipped off to an internal investigation
台词翻译: 据报道，有人提前告知他们有一项内部调查
Example Sentence: A source tipped off the paper about the merger.
例句翻译: 有消息源提前向报社透露了并购的事。
Usage Note: 被动 a source tipped off sb；名词 a tip-off 指线索。

Definition (EN): to avoid something by clever means
Quote from Episode: was the only morning news broadcast to dodge the Me Too scandals
台词翻译: 是唯一躲开了 #MeToo 丑闻的早间新闻
Example Sentence: He dodged the question three times.
例句翻译: 他三次躲开了这个问题。
Usage Note: 职场也指「回避责任」。名词 dodge=闪避动作。

Definition (EN): to get ready for something difficult
台词翻译: 系好安全带／做好准备吧。
Example Sentence: Quarterly reviews are tomorrow. Buckle up.
例句翻译: 明天季度考核，做好心理准备。
Usage Note: 字面系安全带。职场口语里表示「事情要来了」。

Definition (EN): the period of holding a position
台词翻译: 在他们十五年的任期内
Example Sentence: His tenure at the network ended abruptly.
例句翻译: 他在该电视网的任期突然结束了。
Usage Note: 还可指终身教职（美国高校）。拼写是 tenure 不是 tenuer。

Definition (EN): a person or thing permanently associated with a place
Quote from Episode: was a fixture of UBA's news division
台词翻译: 曾是 UBA 新闻部门的台柱
Example Sentence: He became a fixture on the morning circuit.
例句翻译: 他成了晨间节目的常客。
Usage Note: 此义不是「夹具」。动词 fixate 与之不同。

Definition (EN): a person who receives something
Quote from Episode: The recipient of multiple broadcast awards
Example Sentence: The recipient was announced on Monday.
例句翻译: 获奖者于周一公布。
Usage Note: 重音在中间 -cip-。对比 recipient of a grant（受资助者）。

Definition (EN): to comply with the established procedure
Example Sentence: We play by the rules, but we read them carefully.
例句翻译: 我们照章办事，不过条款读得很细。
Usage Note: 职场常暗含反讽：我守规矩，但你不守。

Definition (EN): to screen someone's incoming calls
Quote from Episode: I pushed all your calls because after the show you'll meet with the UBA PR team
台词翻译: 我把你的电话都推了，因为播完你还要见 UBA 公关部。
Example Sentence: His assistant pushes all his calls before eleven.
例句翻译: 助理在十一点前把他的电话都挡了。
Usage Note: 艺人/高管用语。push back a call＝推迟回电。

Definition (EN): deliberately acting slowly to delay a decision
Quote from Episode: the way that the network has been dragging their feet on closing my new deal
台词翻译: 电视台在我新约签约这事上一直拖着不办。
Example Sentence: Procurement has been dragging its feet on the contract for weeks.
例句翻译: 采购在合同上拖了好几周了。
Usage Note: 职场必备。反义 moving quickly / decisive。

Word / Phrase: have them by the short hairs
Definition (EN): to have leverage over someone
Quote from Episode: you have them by the short hairs now
台词翻译: 现在你把他们拿捏住了。
Example Sentence: Once the client signed, we had them by the short hairs.
例句翻译: 客户一签字，我们就拿住他了。
Usage Note: 抓住短发的说法，指完全控制局面。近义 have leverage。

Definition (EN): to decide how a situation is publicly understood
Quote from Episode: I just need to be able to control the narrative so that I'm not written out of it
台词翻译: 我只需要能掌控叙事，别让我被排除在外。
Example Sentence: Announce it before the press finds out, or you lose the narrative.
例句翻译: 要在媒体挖出来之前公布，否则叙事权就没了。
Usage Note: 公关/危机管理核心词。反义 lose the narrative。

Definition (EN): excluded from something you were part of
Quote from Episode: so that I'm not written out of it
Example Sentence: They quietly wrote him out of the partnership.
例句翻译: 他们悄悄把他从合伙关系里剔除了。
Usage Note: write sb out of a deal/credit。字面「从剧本里划掉角色」。

Definition (EN): a crowd waiting to exploit your mistake
释义（中文）: 一屋子等着看你出丑的人
Quote from Episode: That event is gonna be a roomful of vultures waiting for you to fuck up
台词翻译: 那场活动就是一屋子等着你出丑的秃鹫。
Example Sentence: Every quarterly review is a roomful of vultures.
例句翻译: 每次季度考核都像一屋子秃鹫。
Usage Note: 比喻 voracious opportunists。vulture 本义秃鹫。

Definition (EN): to cause extreme stress
Quote from Episode: Why don't you just give me a stroke by 7:00?
台词翻译: 你干脆七点前把我吓出心脏病算了。
Example Sentence: Don't give me a stroke, I'm fine.
例句翻译: 别吓我了，我挺好的。
Usage Note: 夸张说法。真实语境中 stroke 指中风，务必分清。

Definition (EN): sensitive; awkward to raise
Quote from Episode: is fired for predatory behavior is touchy?
台词翻译: 在因性骚扰行为被开除后两天就去领奖，这事很敏感吧？
Example Sentence: Compensation is always a touchy subject in reviews.
例句翻译: 调薪在绩效评估里永远是敏感话题。
Usage Note: 指话题敏感、不好谈。反义 safe（非敏感）。

Definition (EN): to hold your position despite pressure
Example Sentence: Legal stuck to its guns on the indemnity clause.
例句翻译: 法务在赔偿条款上寸步不让。
Usage Note: 字面士兵坚持架枪位置。职场谈判常用。

Definition (EN): to give in under pressure
Example Sentence: They held out for three weeks and then caved.
例句翻译: 他们硬撑了三周还是让步了。
Usage Note: 名词 the cave＝从对方那里得到的让步。

Definition (EN): to resist or demand concessions
Example Sentence: Push back hard on the scope before you sign.
例句翻译: 签字前在范围上狠狠顶一轮。
Usage Note: 同名词 pushback＝反对意见。职场高频。

Definition (EN): happening at the planned time
Example Sentence: Two dependencies slipped but we're still on schedule.
例句翻译: 两个依赖延了，但进度仍在计划内。
Usage Note: 反义 behind schedule。schedule 美式读 /ˈskedʒuːl/。

Definition (EN): the final check before going on air
Example Sentence: Ten minutes to last looks, then we're live.
例句翻译: 十分钟后最后检查，然后就直播。
Usage Note: 电视/演出行业术语。last look 也指「最后的眼神」。

Definition (EN): updated script pages
Example Sentence: Do not go on air without the revised pages in hand.
例句翻译: 手里没有修订稿就别上直播。
Usage Note: 出版与广播通用。a page＝一张稿纸（一页≈一小时节目）。

Definition (EN): your promise
Quote from Episode: I need your word that you will wrap up my negotiation
台词翻译: 我需要你承诺会把我的谈判收尾。
Example Sentence: Give me your word and I'll back you publicly.
例句翻译: 给我个承诺，我就公开支持你。
Usage Note: 英式用法；美式更常说 give me your word／I have your word。

Definition (EN): to finish a deal or a piece of work
Quote from Episode: you will wrap up my negotiation
Example Sentence: Legal wrapped up the contract on Friday.
例句翻译: 法务周五把合同敲定了。
Usage Note: 职场比 finish 更自然。wrap＝收拢、包装。

Definition (EN): into chaos or reversal
Quote from Episode: The whole Mitch thing has turned everything upside down
台词翻译: Mitch 那件事把一切都搅乱了。
Example Sentence: The reorg turned the whole roadmap upside down.
例句翻译: 这次重组把整个路线图全打乱了。
Usage Note: 比 the wrong way up 更强调彻底颠倒。

Definition (EN): direct personal involvement
Quote from Episode: I would like hands-on control from this point on
台词翻译: 从现在起我要求亲自掌控。
Example Sentence: After two co-CEOs she took hands-on control.
例句翻译: 两位联席 CEO 之后她亲自接手掌控。
Usage Note: 反义 hands-off（放手不管）。副词也作 hands-on＝动手型的。

Definition (EN): to do something attention-seeking for effect
Quote from Episode: You pulling this stunt, with the network right now
台词翻译: 你现在跟电视台耍这一套。
Example Sentence: Don't pull a stunt on the client without backing.
例句翻译: 没把握就别在客户面前搞噱头。
Usage Note: stunt＝特技；引申为博眼球的动作。negative publicity。

Definition (EN): to appear mentally unstable
Quote from Episode: make them think you are fucking losing it
台词翻译: 只会让他们觉得你疯了。
Example Sentence: The walkout made them think he was losing it.
例句翻译: 那次罢工让他们觉得他精神出了问题。
Usage Note: 此处指「看起来不正常」，字面 lose 掉。注意与 lose one's temper 区分。

Definition (EN): to be promoted through the levels
Quote from Episode: We came up the ranks together.
台词翻译: 我们是一起一步步升上来的。
Example Sentence: She came up the ranks before running the division.
例句翻译: 她是一步步升上来才管这个部门的。
Usage Note: 常暗示「不是空降的」。rank＝职级。

Definition (EN): through good and bad times alike
Example Sentence: We signed up for each other, for better or worse.
例句翻译: 我们彼此承诺，不論顺逆。
Usage Note: 源自婚礼誓词。婚姻用法最常见，职场/伙伴关系也用。

Definition (EN): a position with no workable option
Quote from Episode: you are putting me in an impossible situation
台词翻译: 你让我陷进了一个无法可解的处境。
Example Sentence: Signing both contracts left us in an impossible situation.
例句翻译: 两份合同都签了，让我们陷入两难。
Usage Note: put someone in an impossible position/spot。更口语是 catch-22。

Definition (EN): to step in and cover someone's role
Example Sentence: Alison filled in at five minutes' notice.
例句翻译: Alison 在五分钟前临时顶了上来。
Usage Note: 此义是「顶替」，不是「填写」。fill in for someone。

Definition (EN): in front of the public eye
Quote from Episode: the first time you're in public since this whole thing happened
台词翻译: 这是这件事发生以来你第一次公开露面。
Example Sentence: He avoided the press but went in public on the record.
例句翻译: 他躲着媒体，却公开表态。
Usage Note: 公开讲＝in public；私下讲＝off the record。

Definition (EN): to step forward publicly to give evidence
Quote from Episode: These women who have come forward
Example Sentence: Two more employees came forward with complaints.
例句翻译: 又有两名员工站出来投诉。
Usage Note: me-too 语境固定说法。特指站出来指控。

Definition (EN): a role that lets you direct others
释义（中文）: 掌权的位置；有权威的角色
Quote from Episode: You were in a position of authority.
台词翻译: 你当时处在有权力的位置。
Example Sentence: As CTO he was in a position of authority over the team.
例句翻译: 作为 CTO 他对团队有权威。
Usage Note: 职场/法律语境。in a position of authority 指上下级关系。

Definition (EN): manicure and pedicure together
Quote from Episode: get your car to take you for your mani-pedi
Example Sentence: She booked a mani-pedi before the presentation.
例句翻译: 她在汇报前预约了美甲。
Usage Note: 日常口语；正式场合分开说 manicure and pedicure。

Definition (EN): a competing broadcast
台词翻译: 我们的节目是收视率上的对手。
Example Sentence: The two networks are morning ratings rivals.
例句翻译: 两家电视网是晨间时段的收视对手。
Usage Note: ratings＝收视率；rivals 此处形容词化。

Definition (EN): to shake hands with people at an event
Example Sentence: He spent forty minutes pressing the flesh at the gala.
例句翻译: 他在晚会上花了四十分钟逐一寒暄。
Usage Note: 政治/公关活动用语，带一点不耐烦的调侃。
